Place dough in lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic, and place in warm place until doubled in size - about 1 hour. Punch down, transfer to parchment-lined sheet pan and let rise 15 to 20 minutes more.
Preheat oven to 475° F.
Transfer focaccia to pan. Dimple surface of focaccia with fingers before adding toppings.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.name: FOCACCIA WITH HERBS
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: For sponge: Make sponge by mixing yeast, sweetener, water, and high-gluten flour together.
Cover sponge with plastic, transfer to warm place until doubled in size (20-30 minutes).
For dough: Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up.
Incorporate into sponge mixture: potato, warm water, olive oil, salt, semolina flour, fresh herbs, and enough whole wheat bread flour to form knead-able dough.
Transfer dough to floured work surface and knead. Dough should be soft and a little sticky. Knead for about 10 minutes.
Transfer dough to oiled bowl, cover with plastic. Rise until doubled in size (30-45 minutes).
Fold and turn dough. Flatten and form focaccia on parchment-lined pizza peel. Cover with damp towel and let rise again 15-20 minutes more, or until doubled in size again.
Brush top of focaccia with olive oil and sprinkle with mixture of fresh herbs, sea salt, and fresh cracked pepper. Dimple surface with fingertips, and transfer to pizza stone. Bake 20-25 minutes.

recipes.name: Fresh Herb Pasta
instructions: Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs and herbs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow and add minced herbs. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE BANANA BREAD
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
In separate medium bowl, whisk together butter, maple crystals, egg, mashed bananas, vanilla extract, and buttermilk.
Whisk wet ingredients into dry. Fold together, making sure to scrape bottom of bowl to mix well. Pour dough into prepared muffin molds.
In small saucepan, melt butter for crumble. Combine butter, maple crystals, and rolled oats in bowl. Transfer crumble to top of bread.
Bake for 30-45 minutes, or until toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean. Remove from oven and allow to rest in pan for 15 minutes, before inverting onto wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE CRÊPES
instructions: Emulsify all ingredients in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free, Egg-Free Mini Pizzas
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet trays with Silpats or parchment generously brushed with olive oil.
In medium bowl, dissolve maple crystals in water and add yeast. Set aside.
In another medium bowl, sift and whisk together rice flour, tapioca flour, and xanthan gum. Add fennel seeds and salt, and mix together. Set aside.

In small pot, add flax seed to boiling water and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until water reaches consistency of egg white. Strain mixture through fine-meshed sieve, and retrieve 2 tablespoons of seedless extract. Set aside.
In stand mixer, blend flaxseed extract, 1 tablespoon olive oil and yeast-maple crystal water. Add flour mixture and beat on high for 2 minutes.
Using tablespoon, dollop batter onto baking sheets, making 6-8 mini pizzas per sheet tray. With circular motion, spread each circle out with spoon to about 2 inches in diameter.
Cover with inverted baking sheet, and let rise 40-45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°F.
Bake each mini pizza 10 minutes without toppings.
Remove trays from oven, and garnish pizzas with toppings of choice. Dribble remaining oil over each mini pizza. Bake another 10 minutes to cook fillings and melt cheese, if using.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Feta-Dill Quick Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix together flour, baking powder, and salt in large bowl.
In separate bowl, combine olive oil, milk, egg, and feta cheese. Add wet mixture to dry, and mix dough to combine. Add dill.
Pour batter into muffin molds and immediately transfer back to oven to bake.
Bake for at least 30-40 minutes. Bread is ready when toothpick inserted in bread comes out clean.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE FLOUR BLEND
instructions: Note: Use only 2 cups of this flour for crepe batter.

recipes.name: GNOCCHI
instructions: Note: For lightest possible gnocchi, potatoes must be baked.
Preheat oven to 400° F.
Prick flesh of potatoes with fork and bake until tender, about 1 hour.

Peel potatoes while still warm and put in medium bowl. Mash potatoes and add egg and salt. Add flour in increments, working it in to bind potato mixture. Add just enough flour to hold dough together. Roll out a few test gnocchi.

Bring pot of salted water to simmer. Add gnocchi. When gnocchi rise to top, count to ten before removing and testing for consistency. If gnocchi are fragile and fall apart, add more flour and make another test batch. When you have right consistency, finish rolling out gnocchi.

Cook gnocchi as described above. You can sauce gnocchi or cook gnocchi and then sauté them in clarified butter for delicious variation. You can cook gnocchi and toss with olive oil and hold them in refrigerator up to overnight before sautéing them.
Variations: Add one of the below with the potatoes: diced herbs; chopped garlic; cooked and chopped Swiss chard.

recipes.name: Green Cabbage Sauerkraut with Ginger and Turmeric
instructions: Place cabbage in large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Squeeze and massage cabbage to release water. Continue to massage and squeeze until enough liquid has been released to create salty brine that covers cabbage by 1/4 inch. Add ginger and turmeric.

Pack tightly into 2 quart wide-mouthed glass jar or ceramic crock (liquid brine must be above cabbage for healthy successful fermentation). If cabbage has not released enough juices to cover, add salted water to jar/crock in a ratio of 1 teaspoon sea salt per 1 cup water.

Place plate or discover cabbage and press down to squeeze more brine to the surface. Cover mouth of vessel with cheesecloth and secure to rim of lid with kitchen twine, rubber band, OR if using airlock lid, fill airlock and secure lid.

Store sauerkraut in dry place for 2 - 4 weeks at room temperature. Be sure to check water level, adding more salt water as needed to ensure the mixture is covered throughout fermentation process. Taste every few days and eat or refrigerate when desired tangy flavor is achieved.
Note: A cooler fermentation area will result in a slower fermentation with complex flavor notes. A warmer area will result in a faster fermentation that may lead to off flavors and cloudy brine.

recipes.name: GRILLED CHICKEN TENDERS WITH PEANUT SAUCE
instructions: Soak 8 wooden skewers in bowl of water to prevent burning on grill.
In medium-size bowl, whisk together sesame oil, tamari, mirin, and red pepper flakes. Add tenders to mixture and marinate for 45 minutes.
Heat cast iron griddle grill over medium heat.
Thread tenders on skewers. Depending on size, use one or two tenders per skewer. Discard marinade.
Grill tenders each side about 4 minutes or until chicken has grill marks and is opaque in appearance. Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Grilled Seitan
instructions: Combine seitan in medium bowl with liquid from package, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, olive oil, and salt. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat cast iron griddle. Grill seitan on each side until grill marks form. Return seitan to bowl with marinade until ready to serve. Serve with Chimichurri Sauce.

recipes.name: HAZELNUT-CRUSTED FLOUNDER
instructions: Preheat conventional oven to 375°F.
Combine hazelnuts and breadcrumbs in food processor. Pulse mixture until uniformly crumb-sized. Transfer mixture to half-hotel pan. Transfer flour and eggs, each to separate half hotel pans.
Dredge fish filet in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer filets to egg mixture, making sure to coat entire filet. Press breading onto filet, completely to coat.

Heat canola oil in large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add filets to pan, careful not to crowd them. Cook each side until golden brown, approximately 1-2 minutes per side. If fish is not cooked through, can pace onto parchment-lined sheet tray and place into oven for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Herb Ravioli with Porcini Mushroom Pesto and Tofu "Ricotta"
instructions: In food processor, combine tofu, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, garlic and miso. Process, stopping few times to scrape down sides, until tofu is smooth with slightly granular texture. Add chopped rosemary and pulse to combine. Remove from processor and set aside. Wash out food processor bowl.
Cover mushrooms in bowl with boiling water, and soak for 20 minutes. Drain mushrooms and clean thoroughly to remove all sand attached to stems. Discard soaking liquid.
Combine mushrooms, garlic, pine nuts, olive oil, salt and black pepper in food processor and process until smooth. Add chives and pulse to combine. Taste for seasoning.

Roll out dough and fill ravioli according to directions (see procedures in Pasta Lecture/Demo), spooning in 1/2 teaspoon of tofu cheese first, then adding heaping 1/2 teaspoon of mushroom pesto on top. Cover with second sheet of dough to encase filling. Ravioli can be frozen, if desired, at this point.
Cook ravioli in 12-inch sauté pan filled with 2-inches of simmering water for 3 to 5 minutes, depending on dryness of your pasta and whether or not they were frozen.
Use slotted spoon to gently lift ravioli out of water. Drain briefly for a moment, then serve immediately.

recipes.name: HERBED QUINOA
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: Toast quinoa in 2 1/2 quart saucepan over high heat, stirring constantly until it smells nutty and browns lightly (5-7 minutes).
Remove quinoa from heat. Add boiling water and salt. Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until quinoa is cooked and all liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with fork and add tarragon before serving.

recipes.name: HIZIKI WITH FRESH LEMON
instructions: Drain off any remaining soaking water from hiziki and discard.
In 10-inch pan, sauté onion in oil for 3 to 5 minutes. Add hiziki, mixing well.
Add enough water to just barely cover hiziki. Add shoyu. Bring to boil. Cover, lower flame, and cook until most of liquid has evaporated – about 30 minutes.
Gently stir in scallions and lemon juice until well mixed. Serve.

recipes.name: Homemade Tofu

ingredients.name: nigari or 1/2 cup lemon juice or 1/2 cup vinegar

instructions: Line wooden tofu mold with 2 layers of wet cheesecloth. Set aside.
Heat 7 1/2 cups water in a 2-gallon pot over medium-high heat.
Puree soybeans in 2 batches with 6 cups cold water in blender (about 2 minutes per batch). Add puree to pot with heating water. Stirring constantly, bring contents of pot to boil.

Strain soybean-water mixture through fine chinois (or through strainer lined with double layers of cheesecloth) into a second large pot, pressing out all excess liquid. Discard soy pulp ('okara') or reserve for later use.
Bring strained soymilk to boil. Reduce heat and gently simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Remove pot from heat.

Dissolve nigari or other solidifier in 1 cup cold water. Add 1/3 of solidifier mixture slowly to hot soymilk, while gently stirring. Cover pot and allow to stand 3 minutes or until milk has separated into soft white curds.
Add remaining solidifier in two more batches, stirring each time and covering for 3 minutes. Soymilk should be completely separated into curds and whey.
Using slotted spoon, ladle bean curd into tofu mold; press with 2-3 pound weight for 25-30 minutes until firm and solid.

recipes.name: HORSERADISH-CRUSTED SALMON
instructions: Heat convection oven to 375°F.
Season filet with salt and pepper.
Combine mayonnaise, parsley, horseradish, lemon zest, lemon, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper in large bowl. Stir to combine.
Spread mixture in even layer over flesh side of fish.
Transfer to half sheet tray lined with lightly oiled parchment paper.
Bake for 5-10 minutes, depending on thickness of fish filet.

recipes.name: Indian-Style Seitan Kebabs with Mango Coulis
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Heat griddle grill. Toss seitan with oil in small bowl. Grill seitan on all sides and set aside. When cool, cut seitan into 1/2-inch pieces (approximately 50). Set aside.

In food processor, puree mango, tomato paste, agave, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, smoked paprika, cumin, fennel, turmeric, and salt, adding apple juice a bit at a time. Mixture should have thick, sauce-like consistency. If more liquid is needed, use reserved mango soaking liquid.
Transfer sauce from food processor to half-hotel pan. Add seitan and roast in oven approximately 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until much of sauce is absorbed.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 1 quart water to boil with 1/2 teaspoon sea salt. Prepare an ice bath. Blanch pearl onions for one minute, shock in ice water, and drain. Remove onion skins and toss onions in small bowl with vinegar. Grill pearl onions until slightly charred. Set aside.
Dice mango into 25-30 half-inch pieces. Reserve mango scraped from pit and other unused cubes for mango coulis.
Place seitan on skewer followed by red onion and mango. Repeat sequence, finishing with one more piece of seitan, mango, and pearl onion.
Transfer leftover mango meat to blender. Add pinch of sea salt and splash of hot sauce. Blend mango mixture with leftover dried mango soaking liquid until smooth consistency is achieved.
Reheat skewers on sheet tray in oven and garnish with mango coulis and cilantro.

recipes.name: Kasha with Egg
instructions: In saucepot, bring stock to boil.
In medium bowl combine kasha with egg, stirring well to combine.
Heat 10-inch sauté pan over medium-high flame and add kasha.
Using wooden spoon, stir constantly, toasting until buckwheat is dry.
Turn off heat under pan and add stock. Quickly cover to avoid sputtering.
Bring back to boil and reduce to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until all water is absorbed.
Note: The above kasha recipe is ideal for side dish yielding a light fluffy texture. Do not use for kasha potato loaf.

recipes.name: LACINATA KALE WITH MATCHSTICK CARROTS
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: In 2-gallon stockpot bring about 6 quarts of water to boil. Add salt. Prepare ice bath.
Blanch carrots in water for about 30 to 40 seconds; shock in ice water and drain. Set aside.
In same pot, blanch kale for 3 to 4 minutes until tender but not mushy. Shock in ice water, drain and set aside.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil, add garlic slices and sauté until garlic slices are just golden. Do not burn! Add kale and carrots. Cook until heated through.

recipes.name: LOCRO (ARGENTINE VEGETABLE STEW)
instructions: Drain beans, wheat berries, and barley. In 4-quart pot, combine beans, wheat berries, and barley with 3 cups water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes.

Add vegetables to simmering beans and grains. Add remaining 1 cup water, bay leaves and salt. Continue simmering for 1 hour, covered, over low heat. Stir occasionally, and add more water if needed. Vegetables should be soft; squash will disintegrate, making thick stew. Add corn and cook another 10 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with Sofrito Topping (recipe below) and chopped scallions.

recipes.name: MEDITERRANEAN ROASTED BLACK COD WITH MUHAMMARA
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In small sauté pan over low heat lightly toast fennel and cumin. Remove from heat.
When spices are cool, powder them in coffee grinder and add allspice and sumac.
Divide black cod into six portions and sprinkle spice mixture on both sides of fish. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer fish to parchment-lined half sheet pan. Lightly brush fish with oil.
Roast fish for about 7-8 minutes or until inside of fish is opaque. Remove from oven and set aside. Serve with Muhammara (recipe below).

recipes.name: MISO-GLAZED WHITE FISH
instructions: Combine sake, mirin, miso, rice syrup, and shoyu in small pot. Whisk to emulsify. Transfer to ice bath to quickly cool.
Place filets in shallow hotel pan and pour marinade over them. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Heat broiler. Lightly oil half sheet tray. Arrange filets skin side down on tray. Broil 5-7 minutes.

recipes.name: Miso-Marinated Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F degrees.
Combine salmon filets in large bowl with miso marinade. Marinate salmon for 30-40 minutes.
Remove filets from marinade and transfer to parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake salmon for 8-10 minutes or until flesh is springy to touch.

Alternatively, heat large sauté pan and add sesame oil. Sear top (presentation side) of salmon filets until caramelized, flip filets, then place sauté pan in oven. Cook 8-10 minutes or until flesh is springy to touch.

recipes.name: Miso-Marinated Tofu
instructions: Turn salamander on high heat.
Pour marinade in 12-inch sauté pan. Place tofu slices in pan.
Bring marinade to boil then reduce to low simmer.
Simmer tofu for 15 minutes on one side, then gently flip tofu and simmer for another 15 minutes on other side. As tofu simmers, marinade should reduce considerably and become thick.
Remove tofu from marinade. Spread any remaining marinade on top of tofu.
Broil tofu under salamander for approximately 5-7 minutes or until it begins to caramelize.

recipes.name: MONKFISH WITH LEMON-CAPER BUTTER

ingredients.name: salt and pepper to season fish

instructions: Heat conventional oven to 375°F.
Dredge filets in flour. Shake off excess.
Heat olive oil in 10-inch sauté pan over medium heat.
Brown filets on both sides.
Transfer fish to sizzle platter, and complete cooking in oven, approximately 10 minutes. Set sauté pan for next step.
Add butter to pan over low heat, melt, and cook until butter achieves light brown color.
Add capers and lemon juice to browned butter.
Transfer fish from oven to plate and garnish with browned butter. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mussels Simmered in White Wine

ingredients.name: unsalted butter or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions: In 1-gallon pot or 12-inch sauté pan, combine wine, onion, garlic, parsley, bay leaf, and butter OR oil. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2-3 minutes. Add mussels, cover and cook for 3-5 minutes over high heat until mussels open. Season with salt and pepper.
Using slotted spoon, remove mussels from pot or pan. Allow cooking liquid to settle in case of sand, and then ladle liquid over mussels. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Olive Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F. In small bowl, combine water, maple syrup, and yeast. Allow mixture to sit about 10 minutes until is foamy.
Add oil, olives, salt, bread flour, and just enough pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table about 10-15 minutes, using remaining pastry flour, until smooth dough has been created.
Place dough in large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in a warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.

Punch down dough. If time permits, place dough back in bowl, rise, and punch down 1 to 2 times more. Divide dough into two equal portions. Form dough into loaves and place in prepared loaf pans or on sheet trays for final rise.
Loosely cover dough with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Allow to rise for about 40 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
Bake bread approximately 30 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should register approximately 190° - 205°.

recipes.name: PAN-FRIED MILLET CROQUETTES
instructions: In sauce pot, dry roast millet over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add water and salt, cover, and bring to boil. Simmer 40 minutes or until water is absorbed.
Transfer millet to large bowl with breadcrumbs and let cool. Squeeze grain until sticky.
Add scallions, parsley, and shoyu to millet.
Using 1/4 cup measure, form croquettes. Mold croquettes with wet hands. Dredge in cornmeal.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in large sauté pan. Prepare plate lined with paper towel for draining.
Fry croquettes until golden brown on each side. Flip once during cooking.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Tempeh
instructions: In sauce pan, combine marinade ingredients.
Slice tempeh into diagonal slabs about 1/4 inch thick.
Combine tempeh with marinade.
Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes.
In colander, drain marinade from tempeh.

In sauté pan, heat enough olive oil to cover bottom half of tempeh slabs. Prepare a plate with paper towels for draining. Pan-fry tempeh on both sides until golden. If broiling, brush tempeh with olive oil and broil on both sides.
Drain cooked tempeh slices before serving.

recipes.name: PINTO BEAN STEW
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil on medium-low flame. Add onion, salt, garlic, and cumin. Sweat until onion becomes translucent. Add beans, salt, bay leaf, chipotle, and water. Cover pot and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 35-40 minutes, or until beans are tender. Remove chipotle from pot, mince, and set aside.
Add peppers and tomatoes; continue simmering for 5 minutes more.
Add minced chipotle and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

recipes.name: Pizza Dough #2

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients together with whisk.
Let sponge sit 20-30 minutes covered with plastic wrap in warm place.
Add salt, oil and water to sponge, then add flours in 1/2 cup increments until incorporated.
Knead about ten minutes. Let pizza dough sit 40 minutes covered with plastic wrap in warm place.
Preheat oven to 475°F.
Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and topping.
Bake on stone 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: POLENTA

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry vinegar

instructions: Optional: toast polenta in sauté pan over medium flame, stirring constantly until it has nut-like fragrance, about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove polenta from pan and let cool to room temperature.
In 3-quart saucepan, mix polenta, salt, pepper, and water, whisking until smooth. Place pan over heat, bring mixture to boil, stirring constantly, until thickened, using medium-high flame.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough so wooden spoon can stand in it.
Season with flavoring options of choice.

recipes.name: POTATO-CRUSTED BASS FILETS
instructions: Drain potatoes, squeeze as much excess water from potatoes as possible with cheesecloth. Set aside.
Combine flour, salt, pepper, and thyme in bowl. Set aside.
Combine and whisk eggs in large bowl.
Liberally season filets with salt and pepper.
Dredge fish filet with flour, shaking off excess.
Transfer filets to egg mixture, making sure to coat entire filet.
Press potatoes onto filet, completely coating them.
Heat non-stick sauté pan over medium heat with 1/4-inch canola oil.
Transfer filets to pan and brown on both sides. If filets are thick, transfer browned filets to 375°F oven to finish cooking.

recipes.name: PUMPKIN, SAGE, AND PECAN RAVIOLI
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Cut squash in half from stem to bottom and place cut side down on parchment-covered sheet pan. Bake about 45 minutes, until fork tender. Let cool a few minutes, then remove and discard seeds. Scoop flesh into bowl and mash with fork. Measure out 2 cups of mashed squash, reserving any extra.

Warm oil in 10-inch sauté pan. Add onions and sauté until caramelized, about 10 minutes. Add pecans and sauté few minutes more. Add squash, mixing until heated through. Stir in sage leaves, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat.
Roll out dough; fill and form raviolis.
Bring 12-inch sauté pan filled with 2 inches of water to simmer. Add raviolis and cook 3 to 5 minutes, depending on dryness of pasta and whether or not they were frozen.
Use slotted spoon to gently lift raviolis out of water. Drain briefly for a moment, then serve immediately.

recipes.name: QUICK SHIITAKE MUSHROOM STOCK
instructions: In small stockpot, soak mushrooms in 2 quarts water for 30 minutes.
Add kombu and bring to boil. Lower flame and simmer 5 minutes.
Strain stock through fine chinois, pressing firmly to extract as much liquid as possible.
Note: Strained mushrooms and kombu can be sliced and used in soup, and other dishes.

recipes.name: QUICK TOFU TERIYAKI

ingredients.name: juice from 1/4 cup peeled and grated ginger

instructions: In blender, combine marinade ingredients. Blend until smooth.
Slice tofu into four slabs of equal thickness.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine tofu with marinade. Bring to boil and reduce to simmer, covered, for 35 minutes.
Drain tofu (reserving marinade) and blot with paper towels to absorb excess moisture.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil and pan-fry tofu over medium-high heat until golden on both sides.
After tofu is cooked, drain any excess oil out of pan and place tofu in warm oven.
Transfer marinade to blender with kuzu and process until smooth.
Pour blended mixture into pan and cook for about two minutes, until liquid is thickened, stirring constantly.
Add tofu to sauce, stirring until well coated.
Serve with rice and steamed vegetables.

recipes.name: Ravioli with Beet Stuffing
instructions: Cover beets with water and simmer until tender. Peel and puree in food processor.
Toast fennel seeds in sauté pan. Remove to spice grinder or mortar and pestle and grind.

Heat butter in 8-inch sauté pan, and sauté shallots until translucent. Add breadcrumbs and sauté until golden, stirring constantly. Add shallot-breadcrumb mixture to beet puree and stir in fennel, ginger, salt and pepper. Stir in egg yolk.

Form ravioli: Roll out pasta dough thinly and cut out disks about 2 1/4 inches in diameter. Put a little stuffing in middle of each dish and brush edge with egg white or water. Fold each disc over into half-moon shape and press edges firmly together to seal. Cook ravioli in boiling salted water until they rise to the surface.

recipes.name: Red Lentil and Toasted Sunflower Burger

ingredients.name: sunflower seeds toasted and ground in food processor

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In pressure cooker, dry roast rice until it has nutty aroma. Add water and pinch of salt. Bring rice to pressure for 30 minutes. Bring pressure down, and drain rice in colander.

While rice cooks, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in 10-inch sauté pan on medium-low heat. Add onions and garlic; sweat for 2-3 minutes. Add sunflower seeds, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Add broccoli stalks, carrots, and celery and sauté for 3 minutes more.
Combine vegetables with rice in food processor. Pulse until mixture becomes slightly sticky and binding. Set rice-vegetable mixture aside in bowl.

Combine lentils in 2-quart pot with 4 cups water and pinch of salt. Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook for 15 minutes or until lentils are soft. Drain lentils in colander for 5 minutes and transfer to bowl with rice-vegetable mixture.
When mixture is cool, add parsley and kuzu. Mix all ingredients well with gloved hands. Form patties using 1/2 cup measure.
Lightly spray or brush 10-inch non-stick pan with olive oil. Brown patties on each side over medium heat and return to parchment-lined sheet pan. Heat patties in oven for 15 more minutes.
Serve with Fresh Ketchup (recipe following).

recipes.name: RICE PILAF
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil and sweat onions until translucent.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil.

Add stock, salt, pepper, and thyme. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 45 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove from heat and keep covered to steam for at least another 15 minutes. Garnish with fresh herbs.

recipes.name: RISOTTO
instructions: In pressure cooker, heat oil over medium flame. Sauté onion, then garlic in oil until translucent.
Add rice and sauté few minutes more.
Add stock and bring pot to pressure. Pressure cook risotto for 35 minutes.
While rice is cooking, prepare an ice bath, bring 1 quart water to boil, and add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Blanch asparagus for 1 minute, and shock in ice water. Drain and set asparagus aside.

Remove pressure cooker from heat, and allow pressure to come down. Open pressure cooker and add saffron, wine, and salt. Cook uncovered for 5-10 minutes more, stirring often, and adding stock if necessary.
Add blanched asparagus just before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper and Mushrooms
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F-400°F.
Combine vegetables, garlic, and olive oil in large roasting pan.
Roast for 30 minutes. Drain and cool.

recipes.name: ROASTED ROOT VEGETABLES WITH TOASTED HAZELNUTS, CILANTRO, AND GARLIC
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Toast hazelnuts until fragrant, approximately 6-7 minutes. Set hazelnuts aside to cool.
Toss carrots, sweet potatoes, parsnips, and shallots in large bowl with olive oil and salt.
Transfer vegetables to sheet tray lined with parchment. Roast vegetables in oven until evenly caramelized, approximately 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Skin hazelnuts by wrapping in towel and vigorously rubbing them. Roughly chop hazelnuts and transfer them to large bowl.
Add vegetables to bowl and toss with parsley, cilantro, and garlic just before serving.

recipes.name: SAFFRON PASTA
instructions: Crumble saffron into eggs and stir to dissolve.
Follow one of the below methods.

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add saffron-egg mixture, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Pour saffron-egg mixture into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: SALT-CRUSTED BAKED BASS
instructions: Preheat oven to 450° F.
Wash fish in cold water and pat dry.
Insert thyme into cavity of fish.
In mixing bowl, whip egg whites until they form soft peaks.
Fold salt into egg whites to combine.
On large, ovenproof platter suitable for serving and presentation, place 1/4 of egg white mixture.
Place fish atop egg white mixture, then cover fish with remaining mixture.
Transfer platter in oven and bake approximately 35 to 40 minutes.
Crack crust with sharp knife and carefully remove.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED CHICKEN BREAST MARSALA WITH CRIMINI MUSHROOMS
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then lightly dust with flour and shake off excess.
Heat olive oil over medium-high flame in 12-inch sauté pan. Cook breasts on each side for approximately 3-4 minutes. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add shallots to pan and sauté for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms to pan and sear until caramelized. Sear in batches, if necessary. Do not crowd pan.
Remove pan from heat, add chicken back to pan, and pour Marsala wine over chicken. Place pan over flame again and tilt pan carefully toward flame to flambé.
When flames subside, add stock and simmer over medium to high heat to reduce stock au sec (almost dry), about 2 to 4 minutes.
Add cold butter cubes to pan one at a time and swirl until dissolved.
Garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: SEAFOOD SAUSAGE

ingredients.name: baby bok choy and red cabbage slaw

instructions: In small sauté pan, heat oil, and add shallots and leeks. Sauté for 2 minutes or until translucent. Transfer to food processor.
Add sole to shallots and leeks in food processor and puree 30 seconds. Add egg whites, and process 15 seconds more. Scrape down bowl and process 15 seconds more.
Transfer mixture to bowl. Fold in chives, salt, and pepper scallops and shrimp. Divide mixture into eight 1/3-cup portions.

Form sausages 4 inches long and 1 1/2 inch thick. Roll each tightly first in parchment (8-inch x 6-inch sheets) and then in foil (8-inch x 6-inch sheets), twisting ends, and poach in simmering water for 9-10 minutes.
Unwrap sausage and cool slightly. Slice each sausage once on bias in middle.

Lightly brush non-stick pan with olive oil. Arrange sausages in pan so as not to crowd them. Brown them lightly on all sides. Serve with dollop of Honey-Mustard Yogurt and side of Baby Bok Choy and Red Cabbage Slaw (recipes following).

recipes.name: Seitan Bordelaise

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Dredge seitan in flour and shake off any excess.
In 10-inch sauté pan over medium-high flame, heat oil and sear seitan until lightly caramelized on both sides. Remove seitan from pan and set aside. Add shallots to pan and sauté until caramelized.
Add seitan back to pan with stock, red wine, shiitake mushrooms, and thyme. Simmer until liquid is reduced to nappé consistency.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Note: Can replace red wine with Marsala wine.

recipes.name: Seitan Croquettes
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onion until caramelized. Transfer to medium bowl and set aside.

Squeeze all excess liquid from seitan. In food processor, pulse seitan to texture of ground beef. Transfer seitan to bowl with onions. Mix in flax mixture, salt, sage, fennel seeds, and sunflower seeds to combine.

Form seitan mixture into small patties using 1/4 cup measure. Dredge in flour. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons oil in same 10-inch sauté pan used to caramelize onions. Pan-sear croquettes for several minutes on both sides.
Combine red onion in small bowl with vinegar, agave, and salt. Mix to combine.
Garnish croquettes with mustard, red onion and chives.

recipes.name: Seitan Kebabs with Yellow Rice

ingredients.name: kuzu dissolved in 2 tablespoons water for thickening marinade

instructions: Soak 25 skewers in cold water for 30 minutes.

In large bowl, combine seitan, onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes with marinade ingredients for 30 minutes. Strain seitan and vegetables from marinade, but reserve marinade to make sauce (step 5).
Heat griddle grill. Make skewers with 2 pieces seitan, 2 pieces mushrooms, 2 pieces tomato, and red onion, alternating seitan and vegetables.
Grill kebabs 3-5 minutes on each side or until grill marks appear. Set aside.
Bring marinade to simmer. Whisk in kuzu slurry, stirring constantly, until marinade thickens to sauce consistency (approximately 5 minutes).
Serve atop or alongside Yellow Rice. Pour marinade sauce over kebabs or serve alongside.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine rice, water, salt, and turmeric. Bring rice to boil, cover pot, reduce heat, and simmer for approximately 40-50 minutes or until all water is absorbed.
Remove rice from heat, and set rice aside covered to steam 10 minutes more.
Fluff rice lightly with fork. Add parsley and mix to combine. Serve alongside or underneath Seitan Kebabs.

recipes.name: SEITAN STEW

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat olive oil over medium flame and sweat onion until softened. Add celery, burdock, carrots, and daikon. Sweat until vegetables begin to soften, about 5-7 minutes. Add mushrooms and sweat until tender, about 1 minute.

Add squash and stock to just cover vegetables, about 6 cups. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat and add bay leaves, seitan, and tamari. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all vegetables are tender and squash has started to break down. Add green beans and simmer until beans are just tender.
Add kuzu slurry and simmer until mixture slightly thickens. Stir in ginger juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with scallions.
Seasonal variation: In Spring/Summer replace green beans with 1 small zucchini (7 ounces), cut into 1-inch roll cut.

recipes.name: SESAME-CRUSTED TUNA
instructions: Season tuna with salt and pepper.
Combine sesame seeds and completely crust tuna.
Heat canola oil in sauté pan over medium heat.
Sear tuna on all sides, approximately 1-2 minutes each side.
Let tuna rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with wasabi and dipping sauce.

recipes.name: SMOKED TROUT TERRINE
instructions: Heat oven to 300°F. Line terrine mold with plastic. Prepare an ice bath.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, heat cream to 160°F and add pinch of saffron. Transfer pot to ice bath and cool cream to room temperature.
Combine trout, lemon juice, salt, pepper, egg whites, and infused cream in food processor.

Puree until smooth and fully combined. Transfer puree to bowl. Fold in shrimp, scallops, parsley, and basil. Transfer mixture to terrine mold. Fold ends of plastic wrap or parchment over top of terrine.
Poach terrine in 170°F water bath for about 35 minutes.
Remove terrine from water bath and cool before refrigerating at least 3-4 hours.

recipes.name: Spelt Pizza Dough

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients with whisk.
Cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 20 to 30 minutes in warm place.
Add water, salt, and oil to sponge, and mix together with wooden spoon. Add flour in 1/2 cup increments.
Remove dough from bowl, form dough into ball and knead on floured work surface. Dough should be soft and a little sticky. Knead for about 10 minutes.
Place dough in lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic and place in warm spot until doubled in size, about 40 minutes. Punch down, shape dough and bake.
Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and toppings.
Bake on baking stone 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: Spinach Pasta

ingredients.name: unbleached all-purpose flour or half all-purpose flour/half whole wheat bread flour

instructions: Press spinach with your hand to squeeze out any excess liquid. Mix spinach with eggs and set aside.

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add spinach/egg mixture; process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to side of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough ball onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.

recipes.name: STIR-FRIED ARAME AND GINGER WITH SOBA NOODLES
instructions: Boil soba until tender, about 8-10 minutes. Drain, rinse in cold water, and set aside.
Coarsely chop arame. Set aside.
Heat wok with both sesame oils. Add ginger and stir well. Add garlic. Cook until ginger and garlic are lightly golden, but avoid burning.
Stir in arame, peppers, and Chinese cabbage. Once cabbage wilts, add soba.
Mix water, tamari, umeboshi vinegar, and maple syrup in small bowl. Pour over vegetables and noodles. Stir until liquid has evaporated.
Add scallions and stir to combine.

recipes.name: TEMPEH “BOLOGNESE”
instructions: Sauté tempeh in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until browned.
Add remaining olive oil and onion with 1 teaspoon of salt. Keep cooking until onions are soft.
Add garlic, oregano and basil (if using fresh oregano and basil, then add in last 10 minutes of cooking). Cook for few minutes longer. Add 1 cup of red wine and reduce until almost dry.
Pour in tomato puree and cook covered for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and rice syrup (if needed).
Have large pot set up with boiling, salted water and strainer or basket that can be easily lifted out.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat approximately 1/2 cup of Bolognese sauce.
Drop one serving pasta (about 4 ounces) in strainer or basket and place in boiling water. Heat through about one minute. Drain pasta.
Combine pasta with sauce and toss to coat. Plate pasta and pour over any sauce left in pan. Garnish plate and serve.
Note: Broccoli should be used as garnish: about 2-3 pieces depending on size.

recipes.name: TEMPEH SAUSAGE
instructions: Cut tempeh into 2-inch pieces and steam for 20 minutes in steamer basket over simmering water. Cool to room temperature.
Grate tempeh on large holes on box grater. Combine grated tempeh with garlic, water, olive oil, tamari, sage, marjoram, thyme, paprika, cayenne, fennel seeds, pepper, and oat flour. Mix well.
Form mixture into walnut-sized balls using 1-ounce ice cream scoop and press into patties. Dredge in cornmeal or flour.
Prepare plate with paper towel for draining. In sauté pan, heat oil and fry patties until well browned on both sides. Drain tempeh.

recipes.name: TEMPEH SCALOPPINI
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)

ingredients.name: sliced fresh shiitake and/or cremini mushrooms

instructions: In medium saucepan, combine shoyu, ginger, kombu, sea salt, and tempeh and water. Cover pan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 25 minutes. Drain tempeh.
Slice tempeh on diagonal into 6-8 thin slices. Dredge each slice in flour. Shake off excess flour.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high heat and fry tempeh until golden on both sides. Drain any excess oil. Add water or stock and wine to tempeh. Cover and bring to boil.
Add sliced mushrooms and garlic, reduce heat to low, and cook covered until mushrooms release juices and become tender.
Add fresh herbs; simmer until liquid thickens (needs to be saucy).
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice and salt to taste.
Garnish with parsley and serve.
Note: Serve with rice, noodles or sautéed greens.

recipes.name: TEMPEH VEGETABLE KEBOBS
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: Whisk together tempeh marinade ingredients in bowl; pour into 1-gallon pot.

Cut each package of tempeh in two. Bring marinade to boil, add tempeh, lower heat, and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Drain tempeh and pat dry, reserving marinade (there should be 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons).

Whisk together vegetable marinade ingredients in mixing bowl. Add all vegetables to marinade and let sit for 20-30 minutes, stirring often. Remove vegetables with slotted spoon (set aside marinade for later use).

Cut tempeh into 24 cubes and toss with oil. Preheat grill while preparing kebobs. Use one piece of each vegetable and two pieces of tempeh for each skewer. Grill kebobs few minutes on each side until grill marks form and vegetables are tender.
Bring reserved tempeh marinade to boil in 2 1/2 quart saucepan; whisk in dissolved arrowroot, stirring constantly until sauce comes back to boil and becomes clear. Use sauce for kebobs.
Note: Kebobs can be baked in 450° F. oven for 20-30 minutes as an alternative to grilling. Brush them occasionally with vegetable marinade as they cook.

recipes.name: TOFU BURGERS

ingredients.name: cooked millet or rice or bread crumbs
extra virgin olive oil or sesame oil
curry powder or other spice blend

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix seeds and shoyu together. Roast on parchment paper until dried and toasted.
Prepare millet (2 cups water to 1 cup millet for 30 minutes) or brown rice (2 1/2 cups water to 1 cup rice for 55 minutes).
Press tofu to remove excess water by placing tofu between paper towels and putting weighted plate on top. Let sit at least 5-10 minutes.
Soak arame in water 10-15 minutes. Drain and chop finely.
Heat oil, sauté garlic, onion, spices, carrot and celery for 2-3 minutes.

Grind sunflower seeds halfway in food processor. In a separate bowl, mash tofu, add sautéed vegetables, 1 cup cooked grain, ground sunflower seeds, arame, ume, tahini, and salt and pepper to taste. Adjust salt if needed. Mix well.
Form 1/2" thick burgers with about 1/2 cup mixture.
Bake burgers at 350°F until set (about 15-20 minutes) or pan fry (dredge in corn meal first) on each side, only turning once until golden (drain on paper towels).
Serve on whole wheat burger bun with lettuce, red onion slice, and mustard.

recipes.name: TOFU TERIYAKI
instructions: Slice tofu in half horizontally. Place tofu on plate between paper towels and weigh down for 20-30 minutes to extract water. Slice pressed tofu into 1/2 inch slabs.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium to medium-high heat and sear tofu slices until golden on both sides.
Drain any excess oil. Add teriyaki sauce to tofu and reduce over high heat until sauce is syrupy (about 15 minutes).

recipes.name: TOMATO PASTA
instructions: Stir tomato paste into eggs.
Follow one of the below methods.
Method - Food Processor:

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add tomato-egg mixture, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Method - By Hand:
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Pour tomato-egg mixture into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: Vegan Dough with Water
instructions: Combine flours and salt in food processor. With machine running, add just enough hot water to make stiff dough that forms a ball. Make sure to add water slowly (over at least 30 seconds) to ensure you don’t add too much water. Dough should not be tacky or sticky.

Remove dough from food processor and knead on lightly floured work surface until smooth and elastic, about 1 minute. Wrap in plastic wrap and let sit at least 15 minutes. (The dough can be tightly wrapped in plastic wrap for several hours.)

recipes.name: VEGAN PASTA DOUGH

ingredients.name: unbleached all-purpose flour or 1 cup unbleached all-purpose flour and 1 cup whole wheat bread flour

instructions: Blend tofu, olive oil, water, and salt in blender under smooth.

In food processor, pulse flour for few seconds to aerate it. Add tofu mixture and process 30 seconds. Squeeze dough into ball. Remove dough to lightly floured work surface and knead for 1 minute, or until smooth. Wrap in plastic wrap and let sit at least 15 minutes.

Variations: Add 1/4 cup of fresh chopped herbs to flour; add chili paste instead of water and/or color olive oil with annatto seeds to produce a red dough; warm water and mix in 1/4 teaspoon of saffron threads; add 1/4 cup well-wrung spinach puree instead of water; add 1/4 cup beet puree instead of water.

recipes.name: WAKAME, SEITAN, AND TOASTED WALNUT CASSEROLE

ingredients.name: freshly ground cracked black pepper taste

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oils over medium flame and sweat onions with salt until translucent. Lower heat and continue to sweat until onions begin to soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized (brown and soft), about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add wakame and seitan. Stir well. Add water and shoyu. Cover pan and bring to boil. Lower flame and remove lid. Simmer until mixture is almost dry, about 15-20 minutes.
In small bowl, whisk tahini, shoyu, and water. Set aside.
Transfer cooked pasta to large bowl and combine with sauté mixture, walnuts, and tahini sauce. Transfer mixture to lightly oiled Dutch oven.
Combine breadcrumbs, olive oil, fresh thyme, and black pepper in small bowl. Top casserole with mixture. Bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: White Bean with Garlic, Rosemary, and Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°F. Toss grape tomatoes in bowl with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Spread tomatoes on parchment-lined sheet tray and roast until well caramelized, an hour or more. Set aside.

While tomatoes are roasting, heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium flame in pressure cooker. Add garlic. The moment garlic sizzles, add rosemary and oregano and stir. Add white beans, salt, and water.
Secure lid to pressure cooker, bring cooker up to pressure, lower heat, and cook beans for 25 minutes.
Bring down pressure by running cold water on lid of cooker. Drain beans, transfer to bowl and add roasted tomatoes. Season with additional salt and pepper, as needed.

recipes.name: WHOLE GRAIN CROUTONS
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line half-sheet with parchment paper.
Toss bread in bowl with oil, thyme, salt, and pepper. Transfer croutons to sheet tray.
Bake until bread is golden in color and crisp in texture. Serve over soup.

recipes.name: Whole Poached Norwegian Salmon
recipes.description: Year-Round
instructions: Combine ingredients for court bouillon in deep hotel pan large enough to hold salmon. Bring to poach temperature.
Wrap salmon in double layer of cheesecloth leaving about 6 - 8 inches at each end of fish.
Twist and knot ends of cheesecloth. Cheesecloth is used to lift salmon out of pan when cooking is completed.
Lower salmon into court bouillon. For accurate cooking time, measure fish at its thickest point. Allow 10 minutes to the inch. At completion, internal temperature of fish should be 140°F.
Remove hotel pan from heat, and let fish cool in bouillon. Drain.
When totally cooled remove skin with paring knife. Decorate surface of fish with thinly sliced cucumbers.
Finish garnishing plate with watercress, lemon slices, cherry tomatoes, radishes, etc.

recipes.name: WHOLE STEAMED FISH
instructions: Rinse fish, removing any remaining scales or blood. Score fish by making two, 3-inch long/1/4-inch deep cuts into each side of fish.
Season outside and cavity of fish with salt and pepper.
In bowl, toss cilantro, scallion, garlic, and ginger together. Stuff half of mixture into cavity of fish.

Combine remaining herb/spice mixture with water, tamari, and sesame oil. Transfer mixture to deep hotel pan. Place lightly oiled perforated pan over mixture. Bring mixture to boil over high flame and reduce heat to simmer. Transfer fish to perforated pan. Cover pan with lid or aluminum foil. Steam fish for 15-20 minutes.
When fish is fully cooked and tender, gently transfer to platter. Ladle steaming liquid, herbs, and toasted sesame oil over fish.

recipes.name: WHOLE WHEAT PASTA
instructions: Pulse flours in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flours onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Pizza

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients with whisk.
Cover with plastic wrap and rise for 20-30 minutes in warm place.
Add water, salt and oil to sponge. Mix together with wooden spoon. Add flour in 1/2 cup increments.
Remove dough from bowl, form into ball and knead on floured work surface. Dough should be soft and pliable. Knead for about 8-10 minutes.
Place dough in lightly-oiled bowl, cover with plastic and place in warm spot until doubled in size about 40 minutes. Punch down, shape dough and bake.
Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and toppings.
Bake on pizza stone from 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: WHOLE WHEAT POPPYSEED BREAD
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F. In large bowl, combine yeast, water, rice syrup, whole wheat bread flour, and 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour and stir until thick like batter. Cover sponge with plastic wrap and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes.
Add oil, salt, poppy seeds, and just enough of remaining whole wheat pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table for about 10-15 minutes or until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.
When dough doubles in size, gently fold and turn dough. Cover with plastic and rise again.
Divide dough into two. Form dough into loaves and transfer to prepared loaf pans or on sheet trays. Cover dough with wet towel and rise one final time (approximately 15-30 minutes).
Bake approximately 30-45 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch.

recipes.name: Wild Rice
instructions: Wash and drain rice.
In small saucepot, add rice to water. Add salt. Bring to a boil, covered, lower heat and simmer about 45 to 50 minutes or until rice is tender (rice should butterfly slightly).
Place rice in colander and drain excess water.

recipes.name: Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: (Vegan)
instructions: Heat convection oven to 350° F. Line a 4 1/2 x 9-inch loaf pan with parchment.
Whisk together flax mixture, canola oil, vanilla, and rice vinegar in bowl. Stir in zucchini and pecans. Set aside.
In separate bowl, sift together coconut sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking soda, baking powder, all-purpose flour and whole wheat pastry flour.
Whisk wet ingredients into dry. Pour batter into loaf pan and bake for 55 minutes.
Let bread cool completely before slicing and serving.

recipes.name: ZUCCHINI PEANUT NOODLE BOWL W/ SRIRACHA STRING BEANS & LEMONGRASS TOFU
instructions: Cut zucchinis in half crosswise, and position on spiralizer. Turn to create zucchini noodles, trimming them with scissors if they are too long. Toss with cilantro before serving.
Add peanuts, water, garlic, sesame oil, maple syrup, lime juice, cayenne, coconut milk and salt to Vitamix, or high-speed blender, and puree until smooth.
Bring medium pot with steamer basket, filled with 2 inches of water to boil. Steam string beans 3 minutes, or until bright green and slightly tender. Cut in half on diagonal.
Heat coconut oil over medium heat in large sauté pan. Cook beans with salt for 2 minutes, stirring often. Add sriracha, syrup, and sesame seeds and cook for additional 30 seconds.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Arrange tofu in single layer in baking dish.

In medium bowl whisk together sesame oil, vinegar, apple juice, tamari, garlic and ginger. Pour over tofu, add lemongrass, and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. Bake uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes, or until tofu is golden and has absorbed most of liquid. Discard lemongrass.
Combine turmeric and sesame in small saucepan. Warm for 30 seconds, remove from heat, strain out turmeric before using.
Arrange noodles in bowl. Top with string beans, tofu, turmeric oil, microgreens, cabbage, and peanut sauce.

recipes.name: 3-BEAN CHILI WITH CASHEW SOUR CREAM

ingredients.name: frozen corn or 1-2 ears fresh corn in season

instructions: In tall, 2-gallon pressure cooker, heat oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, chili powder, cumin, oregano, tomato paste, and garlic. When ingredients start to sizzle, immediately add carrots and avocado leaves. Sweat vegetables for 10-15 minutes, with pressure cooker lid slightly ajar, stirring occasionally.
Add pinto beans, black beans, kidney beans, and vegetable stock. Secure lid of pressure cooker, bring cooker to pressure, reduce heat, and cook for about 30 minutes.

Bring pressure down by running cold water on lid of cooker. Open pressure cooker and add tomatoes, reserved tomato juice, and corn. Simmer uncovered until chili thickens to desired consistency. Remove avocado leaves.
Add lime juice to taste. Garnish with lime rounds, cilantro, scallions, and Cashew Sour Cream.

recipes.name: ALMOND “CREAM” SAUCE
instructions: In blender, soak almonds in 1 cup hot water for at least 15 minutes. Process until smooth, gradually adding remaining cup of water. Strain through fine mesh sieve and return almond milk to blender.
In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, sweat onion in oil with salt until completely soft. Add garlic and cook a few minutes longer, being careful not to brown vegetables.
Add sweated vegetables and miso to almond milk. Process until very smooth, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer sauce back to sauce pan and heat slowly, whisking to break up lumps. Stir in lemon juice and serve immediately.
Note: For tangier flavor, blend 1/2 small clove minced raw garlic into sauce, omitting garlic from step two.
Serving suggestion: Almond "Cream" Sauce is delicious served over pasta with lemon zest and freshly cracked pepper.

recipes.name: ALMOND-OAT CRUST (FOR ALMOND-FRUIT TART)

ingredients.name: melted coconut oil or melted butter

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil 9-inch tart pan and line with parchment paper or use 5-6 four-inch, non-stick paper tart pans.
In food processor, grind almonds, oats, and oat flour together until pulverized to fine meal.
In small bowl, combine maple syrup, salt, and oil or butter. Whisk until emulsified.
Pour maple-oil mixture into food processor, pulsing to form cohesive dough. If dough is too moist to work with, transfer to fridge for 5-10 minutes.
Using fingers, press dough evenly into prepared pan. Blind bake with pie weights to prevent crust from puffing up. Bake 15-20 minutes or until edges of crust are browned. Set aside to cool.

recipes.name: Almond Sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.

Peel off papery outer layers from garlic head, cut off top third of head, rub cut surface with 1 tablespoon olive oil, and wrap garlic in aluminum foil. Roast garlic for 45-60 minutes or until cloves are soft. When cool enough to handle, extract paste from garlic head and set aside.
In 8-inch sauté pan, over medium-high flame, reduce white wine with shallots until almost dry (au sec).
In blender combine shallots, roasted garlic paste, almonds and vegetable stock. Through feed tube, slowly add remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil. Blend until creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: APPLE-MUSTARD SAUCE

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté shallots, onion, carrots, and apples until lightly caramelized.
Deglaze pan with apple juice and vinegar. Reduce liquid until almost dry (au sec). Do not remove vegetables.
Transfer vegetables to 1-gallon pot. Add mustard, 7 cups of warm brown stock, and sachet to pot. Bring to simmer.
In medium bowl, add 1 cup of remaining stock to roux. Whisk to combine.
Return stock and roux mixture to pot. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until sauce thickens and nappé consistency is achieved.
Strain sauce through chinois. Adjust seasonings to taste.

recipes.name: APRICOT-PAPAYA PUREE
instructions: In high-speed blender, blend apricots with papaya, adding a bit of soaking water if necessary to form smooth puree.

recipes.name: ARAME STRUDEL
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In large sauté pan, sauté arame in 2-3 tablespoons sesame oil for 3 to 5 minutes. Add water to pan (arame should be three-quarters covered), and bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer and cook until liquid is evaporated. Stir in shoyu, brown rice syrup, and mirin. Reduce until arame is dry. Add ginger juice. Set aside.
In another medium pan, sauté carrots, onion, and sea salt in 1 tablespoon sesame oil until carrots and onions are tender, approximately 10-12 minutes. Set aside.

On a sheet of parchment paper, stack 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each individual layer lightly with remaining sesame oil. Spoon 1-inch wide strip of arame mixture and carrot mixture horizontally onto near end of phyllo. Using the parchment paper, firmly roll strudel forward into a log. Score rolled log diagonally at 2-inch intervals across its length. Repeat this process using remaining phyllo, arame, and carrot/onion mixture until all mixture and phyllo is used up.
Transfer strudels to sheet pan; brush their tops with sesame oil, and bake approximately 20 minutes, until deeply golden. When cool, slice strudel into individual servings.

recipes.name: ARAME WITH VEGETABLES
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onion for 5 minutes or until translucent. Add carrot and sweat another 5 minutes.
Add arame to onions and carrots. Stir well. Sweat for another minute until arame is heated through.
Add water to cover arame halfway. Bring water to boil. Add shoyu, brown rice syrup, and mirin. Simmer for 20-30 minutes or until all liquid has evaporated.
Add bok choy stems and sweat until stems just become tender. Add leaves and sweat until leaves wilt.

recipes.name: ARUGULA, OLIVE OIL, BALSAMIC REDUCTION
instructions: Combine balsamic vinegar and vanilla in medium pan. Bring mixture to simmer, and cook down to approximately 1/2 cup or until mixture thickens enough to coat back of spoon. Set mixture aside to cool.
Toss arugula, oil, and salt together in bowl. Drizzle balsamic reduction to taste over greens. Add Reggiano parmesan, if using.

recipes.name: ASIAN BUCKWHEAT NOODLE SALAD
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine mushrooms, vinegar, tamari, water, and rice syrup. Bring mixture to boil; reduce heat, and simmer uncovered 3-5 minutes or until mixture slightly thickens. Add carrots and simmer another 30 seconds. Whisk in sesame oil.
Combine vegetables with pasta and toss to combine.
Fan cucumbers around plate, top with noodle salad, and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: ASIAN FLAVORS MARINADE
instructions: In blender, combine all ingredients.

recipes.name: ASIAN SLAW
recipes.description: (SPRING SUMMER)
instructions: Combine cabbage, snow peas, carrots, jalapeno, and cilantro in a medium/large bowl.
Combine dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Pour dressing over vegetables and mix well.
Garnish with black sesame seeds.

recipes.name: BABY BOK CHOY AND RED CABBAGE SLAW (FOR SEAFOOD SAUSAGE)
instructions: Blanch bok choy stalks in small pot of lightly salted, boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain and shock in ice water. Cut into 1/2-inch diagonals. Blanch leaves for 10 seconds. Drain and shock in ice water. Wring out excess water from leaves and finely slice.
Combine bok choy stems in bowl with cabbage, carrots, and scallions.
Whisk dressing ingredients together and combine with slaw.
Arrange 1 cup slaw mixture in middle of large plate.
Top with 2 pieces of Seafood Sausage and dollop of Honey-Mustard Yogurt.

recipes.name: BAGELS
instructions: In large bowl, combine water, rice syrup, and yeast. Proof for 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.
Add olive oil and salt to yeast mixture. Stir together bread and pastry flour. Add enough flour to yeast mixture to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough using remaining flour as necessary, about 10-15 minutes, or until dough is smooth.
Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare 2 sheet pans lined with oiled parchment. Bring 1 gallon water to boil and preheat oven to 400° F.
Fold/turn dough. Rise again.
Divide dough into 16 equal-sized balls (3 ounces each by weight).
Form dough into bagel shapes by rolling to 8-inch strips and overlapping and rolling ends or poking hole through center and spreading dough apart.

Place toppings in bowls. Boil 3-4 bagels at a time for 30 seconds, flipping once or twice. Remove from pot with spider and turn bagel face side down into toppings. Gently lift bagels out of topping and transfer to prepared baking sheets. Repeat process until all bagels have been boiled.
Transfer bagels to oven and bake approximately 20-25 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch.

recipes.name: BAKED MILLET CROQUETTES
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In sauce pot, dry roast millet over medium heat, stirring constantly for about 10 minutes or until it smells like popcorn.
Add water and salt to millet and bring to boil. Simmer covered 30 minutes or until water is absorbed. Transfer millet to large bowl and cool.
Add sunflower seeds, scallions, parsley and carrots to millet. Add shoyu to taste, and squeeze mixture together with hands until soft and sticky.
Using 1/4 cup measure, form croquettes and bake on parchment-lined sheet tray until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

recipes.name: BAKED QUINOA WITH PEAS AND HERBS
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
Transfer quinoa to 8 x 8 baking casserole. Roast about 20 minutes or until quinoa is dry. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and stir into quinoa. Bake 5 minutes more, stirring once or twice.

Add water and 1/2 teaspoon salt to quinoa. Tightly cover with tin foil and bake 20 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove from oven and let sit covered 5 minutes. Remove foil and fluff with fork. Place quinoa into bowl and let cool.
Add peas, parsley, cilantro, chives, remaining 1 teaspoon oil, and lemon juice to cooked quinoa. Season with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.

recipes.name: BALINESE CHILE MARINADE
instructions: Combine olive oil, water, garlic, red onion, tomato puree, ginger juice, macadamia nuts, jalapeno pepper, turmeric, red pepper flakes, salt and lime juice in blender. Process to make thin paste. Add water to thin if necessary.

recipes.name: Barbecue-Style Rub
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients.
Toss food being grilled in rub (tempeh, tofu, chicken, or fish) in spice mixture. Let food marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour before grilling.

recipes.name: Basic Marinade
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients.
Marinate vegetables and grill.

recipes.name: BASIL-WALNUT PESTO
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Toast walnuts on sheet tray for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer to strainer. Rub walnuts against strainer over bowl to loosen some of skins. Whatever readily comes off is enough.
Transfer walnuts from strainer and add 3/4 cup to food processor. Add remaining ingredients.
Process everything until smooth. Chop by hand remaining 1/2 cup of walnuts into pieces. Reserve for garnish.

recipes.name: Beet Chips
instructions: Heat oven to 200°F.
Combine beets in small bowl with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Transfer beets to Silpat and bake until crispy, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: BEET SALAD WITH GREENS AND PISTACHIO-CRUSTED GOAT CHEESE MEDALLIONS
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)
instructions: In medium-size pressure cooker, combine beets with salt and water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to full pressure, lower heat, and cook beets until just tender when pierced with a sharp knife (large beets – 30 minutes; medium beets – 20 minutes; small beets – 15 minutes).
Drain, cool, and peel beets. Cut into thin 1/8-inch rounds with a mandolin. Set aside.
Puree all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy. Pour half of the dressing over the cooked beets and toss.
Roll edges of cheese rounds in pistachios. Transfer rounds to refrigerator until service.
Toss watercress with remaining dressing.
Arrange plate with endive, watercress, beets, orange supreme, and cheese rounds.

recipes.name: Beet Terrine
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine grapefruit, orange, and beet juices with agave. Cover pan and bring to boil.
Reduce heat to simmer and add agar powder, stirring continuously for 5-10 minutes or until agar is dissolved. Add salt and stir to combine.
Pour 1/2 cup of mixture into each ramekin. Refrigerate until mixture sets, about 20 minutes. Using small offset spatula, carefully remove terrine from ramekin mold.
Top each terrine with dollop of sour cream, chives and micro-greens.

recipes.name: Bernaise
instructions: Reduce all ingredients at simmer to 1-2 tablespoons.
Cool reduction and strain before adding to yolks in Hollandaise recipe (above).

recipes.name: Beurre Blanc
instructions: In 8-inch sauté pan over medium flame, reduce vinegar with shallots until almost dry (au sec).
Add heavy cream to pan and reduce until mixture thickens slightly. Reduce heat to low.
Add butter, whisking in a few pieces at a time.
When all butter is incorporated, season to taste.
Strain sauce through chinois. Re-heat carefully over very low flame.

recipes.name: BLACK BEAN SALAD
instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, cumin, fennel, and bay leaf in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove bay leaf and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together lime juice, remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with radish, scallions, and tarragon.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: BLACK-EYED PEA SALAD
instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and kombu in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove kombu and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper, vinegar, red pepper flakes, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with celery, tomatoes, olives, scallions, and parsley.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: BLACKENING SPICE MIX
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

recipes.name: BLENDER MAYONNAISE
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil in blender and process until completely smooth.
With motor running, add oil very slowly, in steady stream. As mixture starts to thicken, oil can be added a bit more quickly.

recipes.name: BLUEBERRY PUREE

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen and thawed blueberries

instructions: Puree blueberries and agave nectar in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: Bolognese Sauce with Chicken

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat 3 tablespoons of oil over medium flame. Add ground chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring often to prevent any scorching. Remove chicken from pan.
Add remaining tablespoon of oil over medium-high flame.
Add onion and carrots. Sauté until golden.
Lower flame to medium, add garlic, salt, fennel, oregano, and tomato paste. Sweat until all vegetables are tender.
Add ground chicken back to pot and mix to incorporate. Continue to sweat few minutes longer.
In Vitamix, blend whole tomatoes and juices.
Add puree to pot and simmer until thickened to desired consistency.
Add rice syrup and basil. Simmer few minutes more. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: Brandade
instructions: Combine potatoes, milk, and cream in large sautoir. Bring mixture to scald, and simmer until potatoes are almost tender. Add rinsed salt cod and continue to cook until potatoes and cod are completely tender. Remove from heat.
In small sauté pan, heat oil and garlic together. As soon as garlic begins to sizzle, remove from heat and set aside.
Carefully strain potatoes and fish from milk/cream mixture and transfer to stand mixer set up with paddle attachment. Retain milk/cream mixture for next step.
Add in 1 cup of milk/cream mixture, garlic/oil mixture, and lemon juice. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve on toasted baguette.

recipes.name: BROILED AND/OR BAKED POLENTA
instructions: Preheat broiler or preheat oven to 350° F.
Pour hot polenta onto parchment-lined half-sheet tray, and spread with lightly oiled spatula to 1/2 inch thickness. Let set until firm, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Combine garlic, olive oil, and salt. Set aside.
Cut polenta into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
Transfer cut polenta to parchment-lined sheet tray for baking or lightly oiled sheet tray (no parchment) for broiling. Brush top side with garlic oil.
Broil or bake polenta until golden and crisp (approximately 2 minutes in broiler or 10-15 minutes in the oven). Flip over with spatula, brush other side with oil, and broil.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Brown Basmati Rice Variation #2
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In small baking dish, dry roast rice in oven until dry. Stir oil into rice and bake few minutes more, stirring occasionally.
Add water, salt, and kaffir lime leaves; cover dish tightly with tin foil.
Cook covered, about 50 to 60 minutes, or until all water is absorbed.

recipes.name: BROWN BEEF STOCK

ingredients.name: water or enough to cover by 2 inches
white or red wine or 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar

instructions: Brown bones and vegetables by roasting first in 450° F oven. Simmer 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.name: BUTTER-POPPYSEED SAUCE
instructions: Heat butter in 8-inch sauté pan and stir in ground poppy seeds.
As soon as ravioli are cooked, remove them with slotted spoon to pre-warmed plates. Pour poppy seed butter over them and sprinkle with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: BUTTERNUT MINESTRONE
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onions with salt and red pepper flakes until onions are translucent. Add leeks, carrots, celery, and garlic. Continue sweating until vegetables begin to soften, about 5-7 minutes.
Add white beans, tomatoes, stock, rosemary, and sage to pot with vegetables. Simmer with lid ajar, until beans become just about tender, about 40 minutes.
Add butternut squash to pot and continue to simmer until squash begins to break down and soup thickens.
Add green beans and cook until tender, 4-5 minutes.
When beans are tender, season soup with vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Garnish soup with parsley and parmesan (if using).

recipes.name: CABBAGE SALAD WITH PEANUT DRESSING
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: Combine tofu in 12-inch sauté pan with coconut milk, 1/4 cup of the tamari, lime juice, and rice syrup. Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until mixture thickens. Set aside.

Prepare an ice bath. Bring 3 quarts water to boil. Add 1 tablespoon salt. Blanch cabbage in for 2 minutes. Transfer cabbage with slotted spoon to ice bath. Drain cabbage in colander for about 5 minutes. Squeeze out any excess moisture from cabbage and set aside.

Bring water back to boil. Transfer noodles to large bowl. When water comes to boil, pour water over noodles and let noodles steep for 10-15 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Toss noodles with remaining 1/4 cup of tamari.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, heat oil on medium flame. Sweat onion, garlic, salt, and chili powder until onions are translucent. Add lime zest, lime juice, coconut sugar, and tamari.
In a small bowl, whisk coconut milk and peanut butter, stirring until smooth. Add to onion-garlic mixture and simmer gently 2-3 minutes or until sauce thickens to desired consistency.
Remove sauce from heat and cool to room temperature. Toss half the peanut sauce with noodles.
Pool remaining peanut sauce on bottom of plate. Arrange plate with tofu, noodles, cabbage, snow peas, cucumbers, and peanuts.

recipes.name: CANNELLINI BEAN SALAD
instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and bay leaf in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 25-30 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove bay leaf and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt, black pepper, mustard, lemon juice, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with red peppers, red onion, olives, and basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Seasonal variation: In Winter/Fall, substitute 1/4 teaspoon freshly chopped rosemary for basil.

recipes.name: Carrot-Beet Sauce

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Combine carrots and beets with water to cover in a medium pressure cooker and cook until vegetables are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain vegetables and let cool. Reserve cooking liquid.
In 1-gallon sauce pan, heat oil over medium flame, sweat onion with salt and garlic until onions are translucent. Add oregano, basil, and fennel. Continue to sweat a few minutes longer.
Puree carrots and beets in blender with half of onion-garlic mixture, 2 cups reserved cooking liquid, miso, umeboshi paste, and balsamic vinegar.
Return sauce to sauce pan and add remaining onions and garlic. Add remaining 1/2 cup cooking liquid to achieve proper consistency, if needed.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
