recipes.name: CARROT ONION STOCK
instructions: In 3-gallon stockpot, heat oil. Add vegetables and sweat.
Add water to cover (7-8 quarts) and bouquet garni. Bring to boil and skim off foam. Simmer, partially covered, for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Strain immediately through chinois.

recipes.name: CASHEW CREAM
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: CASHEW SOUR CREAM
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: CAULIFLOWER TERRINE

ingredients.name: cauliflower - 1 pound cored and cut into florets

instructions: In pressure cooker, combine beans with 1 cup stock, thyme, and salt. Bring cooker to pressure and cook beans 20 minutes. Lower pressure, drain beans, and remove thyme stems. Reserve for step 2.

Blend remaining 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock and blanched almonds in VitaMix until smooth. Strain milk through nut bag or chinois into 2 1/2 quart pot. Add agar powder and bring to milk to simmer. Stir constantly until agar dissolves, about 10 minutes. Add beans to pot and set aside. Rinse out Vitamix for use in step 5.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Turn heat down, and sweat onions, garlic, 1 pound cauliflower florets, and salt, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender. Transfer vegetables to large bowl, and add bean-almond milk mixture. Set aside.
In same sauté pan, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Sear sliced cauliflower on each side until golden. Drain on paper towels. Set aside.
In VitaMix, combine almond milk-bean mixture and vegetables (minus the sliced/seared cauliflower). Blend until smooth. Fold chives into mixture. Adjust seasonings.
Line terrine mold with parchment. Arrange seared cauliflower slices on bottom of mold. Pour puree into mold. Refrigerate and set until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: CELERIAC WITH GRILLED ASPARAGUS AND EGGS
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring water to boil with salt. Add celeriac, vinegar, and rice syrup. Lower heat and simmer until celeriac is just tender. Transfer celeriac with slotted spoon to medium bowl.

Add lemon juice and 6 tablespoons olive oil to pot with cooking liquids. Increase heat to medium-high and reduce liquid until syrupy in texture. Season with salt and pepper and pour half of reduced cooking liquid over celeriac. Set aside.

Combine egg with one-inch water to cover in 2 1/2 quart pot. Cover pot and bring to boil. Remove pot from heat and allow egg to remain in hot water for about 8 minutes. Shock egg in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and grate egg through a grater or sieve. Set aside.
Combine asparagus in bowl with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine.
Heat cast iron griddle grill until hot. Grill asparagus until slightly charred but still firm in texture. Toss with remaining half of reduced cooking liquid and set aside.
Arrange spinach on plate. Arrange bundle of celeriac next to bundle of asparagus. Garnish with grated eggs and hazelnuts.

recipes.name: CEVICHE
instructions: In large bowl, combine scallops, jalapeno, red pepper, onion, tomato, garlic, rice syrup, cilantro, parsley, salt, pepper and citrus juices. Toss gently but thoroughly, being certain scallops are well coated with citrus juices.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30-60 minutes, or until scallops lose their translucent appearance. Stir occasionally.
Serve in individual chilled bowls or glasses garnished with avocado slices and parsley.

recipes.name: CHERMOULA SAUCE
instructions: In VitaMix, combine all ingredients until well blended.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Pâté
instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 12-inch sauté pan, melt 2 ounces butter over medium-high heat. Add chicken livers and sauté until brown on outside and still very pink on inside. Transfer livers from pan to bowl and chill over ice bath.

Using same pan, lower heat and add onions. Sweat with salt until translucent. Lower heat, and continue to cook until onions soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized, about 15-20 minutes.

Add garlic along with bay leaves, thyme, and pepper and sweat until fragrant, about 1 minute more. Remove onions from pan and deglaze with Cognac or brandy. Add onions back to fond and stir to combine.
Discard bay leaves. Transfer onion mixture to bowl and cool over ice bath to room temperature.
Puree chicken livers and onion mixture in food processor, adding remaining 2 ounces of chilled butter in pieces while pulsing to blend. Adjust seasoning, to taste.
Pack and smooth pâté into 3 individual ramekins or small molds (about 4 ounces each). Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: CHICKEN STOCK

ingredients.name: brown rice vinegar or cider vinegar

instructions: Simmer 1 1/2 to 4 hours.

recipes.name: CHICKPEA-ARUGULA SALAD
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: Combine chickpeas, water, cumin, and salt in stockpot.
Bring beans to simmer, lower heat, and cook 45-60 minutes, adding water as needed, until beans are tender. Drain beans.
While beans are still warm, toss with dressing. (recipe below).
Let beans cool to room temperature and, right before service, add arugula, olives, parsley, and basil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Chimichurri Sauce
instructions: Roughly chop parsley and transfer to food processor.
Add garlic, onion, vinegar, lemon juice, and oregano to food processor with parsley and pulse to combine.
Add olive oil through feed tube and continue to process for 30 seconds or until sauce is blended, but still retains some texture. Season to taste.

recipes.name: CLASSIC BARBEQUE SAUCE
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine all ingredients and simmer on medium-low heat, stirring often, until nappé consistency is achieved.

recipes.name: Classic Béchamel

ingredients.name: sea salt and ground white pepper

instructions: Add onion piqué to milk in 2 1/2 quart saucepan and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid scorching.
Remove piqué onion from pot. Set milk aside to cool.
In 10-inch sauté pan, combine flour and butter. Stir with wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes. Let roux cool.
Slowly and gradually whisk 4 cups cooled milk into warm roux.
Simmer sauce for approximately 20-25 minutes until thickened and reduced to nappé consistency.
Strain sauce through fine chinois. Add additional 1 cup milk on low flame, if needed.
Note: Piqué is a bay leaf tacked with whole clove on peeled halved onion.

recipes.name: CLASSIC BUTTER AND SAGE SAUCE
instructions: Heat butter until it browns slightly and add sage leaves.
As soon as ravioli are cooked, remove them with slotted spoon, arrange on plates, pour sage butter over.

recipes.name: COBB SALAD
instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Season to taste and set aside.
Sear bacon in 10-inch sauté pan on medium-low heat until crisp on both sides. Transfer to paper towels to drain excess fat. Cool, crumble, and set bacon aside.

Combine chicken stock, salt, bay leaf, and thyme in 2 1/2 quart saucepan and bring to boil. Add chicken, lower heat, and poach until tender and flesh is opaque. Transfer chicken to plate and cool to room temperature. Cut into medium dice. Set aside.

Combine eggs in 2 1/2 quart pot, cover with 1 inch of water, cover pot, and bring to boil. Turn off heat and allow eggs to remain in hot water for about 8 minutes. Shock eggs in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and chop eggs into medium dice.
Combine romaine and arugula. Arrange bacon, chicken, eggs, avocado, and tomatoes over greens. Drizzle with dressing and serve.

recipes.name: Cocktail Sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, and serve with poached shrimp.

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.description: (Fall/Winter)
instructions: Combine almonds in 2 1/2 quart pot with water and salt. Bring to boil, cover, and remove pot from heat. Let almonds soak for 20 minutes.

In blender, combine almonds, soaking water, garlic paste, mustard, agave syrup, vinegar, lemon juice, canola oil, salt, and pepper. Blend until creamy, adding water a little at a time until consistency is similar to mayonnaise. Set aside.
In large bowl, combine cabbage (green and red) with yellow pepper and carrots.
Toss dressing with vegetables. Fold in parsley and dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF ASPARAGUS SOUP
instructions: Trim tips of asparagus spears and set aside. Cut remainder of stems into 1-inch pieces. Prepare ice bath.

In small saucepan, bring 2 1/2 cups of salted water to boil. Blanch asparagus tips until tender (1-2 minutes); shock tips in ice water. Reserve cooking liquid (about 2 cups). Set aside tips for garnish.

Warm oil in 1-gallon sauce pan. Add leeks with pinch of salt and sweat over medium-low heat for 7 to 10 minutes or until soft but not brown. Add oats, asparagus stems, reserved cooking liquid with enough water or stock to equal 4 cups. Add bouquet garni and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer, partially covered for about 30 minutes or until oats are soft.
Remove bouquet garni and discard. Puree soup in blender until very smooth.
Return soup to pot; thin if desired with water or stock. Adjust seasonings with salt, pepper and lemon juice. Add butter if desired for richer consistency.
Pour soup into bowls and garnish with chopped parsley and reserved tips.

recipes.name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Peel and slice broccoli stems. Separate broccoli florets into bite-size pieces. Set aside.
In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onion and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Sweat until onions are translucent, about 10 minutes. Stir often to prevent browning.
Add stock, rice, and cashews to pot. Raise heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Set aside.

In separate 1-gallon pot, bring 2 quarts water to boil with remaining salt. Prepare ice bath. Blanch broccoli until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain broccoli and transfer immediately to ice bath. Drain broccoli again.
Combine onion-rice and broccoli in Vitamix. Blend until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH ARBORIO RICE
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and rice to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar, 25 minutes, or until carrots and rice are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH OATS
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened, about 5-8 minutes. Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and oats to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar 25 minutes, or until carrots are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH POTATO
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and potatoes to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar, 25 minutes, or until carrots and potatoes are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CURRIED SWEET POTATO SOUP
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat coconut oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, and curry powder. Sweat until onions are translucent.
Add sweet potatoes and stock to pot. Raise heat bring and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar until potatoes are tender.
Puree soup in blender until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and whisk in coconut milk. Season to taste with salt and lime juice.
Garnish with lime rounds.

recipes.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: (Fall/Winter)
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat butter or olive oil. Add shallots and sauté until translucent. Add flour; stir 4-5 minutes, until toasted.
Add stock 1 cup at a time, whisking to blend. Bring soup to simmer, add salt.
Add mushrooms to soup. Simmer 30 minutes.
Puree soup in blender. Add sherry and black pepper. Adjust seasonings. Serve garnished with parsley sprig.

recipes.name: CREAM OF MUSHROOM SOUP WITH ROUX

ingredients.name: salt and pinch freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil on medium flame. Sweat shallots and mushrooms with salt until tender, about 10-12 minutes. Add sherry, reducing until almost dry. Add flour, and stir 5 to 7 minutes.
Add stock, 1 cup at a time, whisking to blend. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, with lid ajar, for 30 minutes.
Puree soup in blender until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: CREAMY ARTICHOKE DRESSING

ingredients.name: artichoke cooking liquid or vegetable stock

instructions: Arrange artichokes in steamer basket (see technique above) and steam until tender, about 20 minutes. Set artichokes aside to cool. Reserve any extra steaming liquid.

Remove leaves and choke from cooled artichokes, leaving just heart and stem. Peel outer layer of stem. Cut each artichoke heart into 4 pieces an remove any fibrous material. Blend artichoke hearts with garlic, lemon juice, rice syrup, chives, salt, pepper, and olive oil, adding artichoke water as necessary for desired creamy consistency.

recipes.name: CREAMY CARROT SOUP WITH POTATO
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium-low heat. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot and sweat carrots over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and potatoes to pot. Raise heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 25 minutes, covered, until carrots are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Add lemon and ginger juice. Readjust seasonings.
Garnish with dill and serve.

recipes.name: CREAMY SWEET POTATO BISQUE WITH CASHEW CRÈME FRAICHE AND CANDIED PECANS
instructions: For sweet potato bisque: In 1-gallon pot, heat coconut oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. Sweat until onions are translucent. Add sweet potatoes and stock to pot. Raise heat bring and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar until potatoes are tender.
Puree soup in blender until creamy. Return soup to pot. Re-heat and whisk in coconut milk. Season to taste, adding in vinegar.
For cashew crème fraiche: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.
For candied pecans: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line half sheet tray with parchment paper.
In small saucepan, heat syrup and maple crystals. Add salt, smoked paprika, and cayenne.
Combine nuts with syrup in small bowl. Transfer to sheet tray and bake 5 to 7 minutes. Cool in refrigerator until cold enough to crack.

recipes.name: Creole Sauce

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Strain whole tomatoes from juice. Reserve juice and set aside. Blend whole tomatoes in food processor.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil over low heat. Add garlic and salt. Sweat until garlic softens (do not burn garlic). Add scallions, celery, red pepper flakes, and pepper. Sweat until vegetables are tender.
Raise heat to medium-high and add blended tomatoes to pan. Sauté until tomatoes begin to caramelize.
Lower heat and add agave and reserved tomato juice. Simmer until sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: Croutons for Vegan Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Year-Round

ingredients.name: loaf french or italian whole wheat bread

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F.
In deep bowl, toss bread cubes with oil and salt until each cube is well covered.
Spread croutons in single layer on parchment-lined sheet tray. Bake until croutons are crisp and evenly brown (20-30 minutes), turning often.

recipes.name: CRUCIFEROUS SALAD
instructions: Bring 1-gallon water to boil with 1 tablespoon salt. Prepare an ice bath.
Blanch broccoli, broccoli stems, and cauliflower separately – broccoli for 30 seconds, cauliflower for 1 minute. Shock blanched vegetables in ice water.
Drain and transfer broccoli, broccoli stems, and cauliflower to bowl and add Brussels sprouts.
In Vitamix, combine dressing ingredients. Process until creamy and smooth, and more water if needed.
Toss vegetables in dressing and serve garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Cucumber-Citrus Salsa (for Poached Salmon)
recipes.description: Spring/Summer
instructions: Combine all ingredients and adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: CUCUMBER-DULSE SALAD
instructions: Score skin of cucumbers along length with peeler or zester. Slice thinly into rounds and sprinkle with salt. Set aside for 30 minutes. Rinse, if too salty.
Quickly rinse dulse in bowl of cold water, until softened. Squeeze excess liquid out. Finely chop dulse.
Combine dulse and cucumbers in medium bowl. Mix well.
In small bowl, whisk, rice vinegar, garlic, and mustard. Slowly drizzle in olive oil and whisk to combine. Pour dressing over vegetables. Let marinate 15-30 minutes.

recipes.name: CURRIED CHICKEN SALAD ON PAPADAM WITH YOGURT RAITA
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, braise chicken thighs with stock, sachet, spices (ginger, curry, cumin, and cayenne, and cinnamon stick), and salt for 45 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. When cooled, remove skin and bones. Chop chicken into small pieces, set aside.
Reduce braising liquid until you have about 1/4 cup syrupy liquid. Remove sachet. Reserve syrupy liquid for dressing.
In bowl, combine chicken, red onion, cilantro, and pistachios.
In small bowl, whisk together yogurt, reduced braising liquid, lime, salt and pepper. Add dressing to chicken salad.
Place approximately 2 teaspoons chicken salad on fried papadam. Garnish with dab of yogurt, slice of cucumber, and sprig of cilantro.

recipes.name: CURRIED RED LENTIL SOUP WITH COCONUT MILK (VEGAN)
instructions: Heat coconut oil in 3-quart pot over medium-low flame. Add onion, salt, garlic, carrot, and curry powder. Sweat vegetables covered, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 10 minutes.
Add lentils, stock, and bay leaf. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, and cook partially covered until lentils are broken down, approximately 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf.
Add cauliflower florets, and simmer until tender. Remove 2 cups of soup and purée in blender until creamy. Add blended ingredients back to pot.
Add coconut milk, ginger juice, and lime juice.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro and shredded coconut.

recipes.name: CURRIED RED LENTIL WITH COCONUT MILK (DAIRY)
instructions: Heat ghee in 3-quart pot over medium-low flame; add onion, salt, garlic, carrot, and curry powder. Sweat vegetables covered, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 10 minutes.

Add lentils, stock, and bay leaf. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, and cook partially covered until lentils are broken down, approximately 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Add cauliflower florets and simmer until florets are tender. Remove 2 cups of soup and purée in blender until creamy. Add blended ingredients back to pot.
Add coconut milk, ginger juice, and lime juice. Stir to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro and shredded coconut.

recipes.name: Curry Marinade
instructions: In 8-inch sauté pan, heat oil and fry garlic and spices until fragrant (30 to 60 seconds), taking care not to burn them.
Cool for approximately 10 minutes. Puree mixture in blender.

recipes.name: DARK ONION SOUP WITH WHOLE GRAIN CROUTONS
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame and sweat onions with salt until translucent. Lower heat, and continue to sweat until onions begin to soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized (brown and soft), about 30-40 minutes. Add black pepper, sherry, and garlic and continue cooking until sherry reduces and garlic softens.
Add thyme sprigs, bay leaf, and brown stock. Simmer 20-25 minutes.
Season to taste with tamari and vinegar.

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs with Beet Chips
recipes.description: (Year-Round)
instructions: Prepare ice bath.
In 2 ½ quart saucepan, bring water and beet juice to boil. Add vinegar and salt. Set aside.
In 1-gallon pot, combine eggs with enough water to cover by one inch. Cover pot and bring water to boil. Immediately remove pot from the heat and allow eggs to sit covered for 8-9 minutes.
Transfer eggs to ice bath, allowing them to cool for 1 full minute. Remove eggs ice bath, crack shells on hard surface, and peel eggs carefully.
Transfer eggs to pot with beet juice for about 1 hour. Remove eggs from pot and gently dry them.
Slice eggs in half and remove yolks. Transfer yolks to food processor with yogurt, mustard, salt, and pepper. Blend to creamy, pipe-able consistency. Season to taste.
Place seasoned yolk mixture in pastry bag with star tip and pipe about 1 tablespoon into each dyed egg white half. Garnish with chives and beet chips (recipe below).

recipes.name: DILL PICKLES
instructions: Combine salt and water in pitcher and stir until the salt has dissolved.
Rinse cucumbers thoroughly and snip off the blossom end stem. Set aside.

Place half peppercorns, garlic, mustard seed, and fresh dill into clean half-gallon fermentation jar or crock. Add cucumbers to crock on top of aromatics. Add the remainder of peppercorns, seeds, garlic, and dill. Pour brine mixture over cucumbers to cover them completely.

If using crock or jar without airlock lid, pour remaining water into 1-gallon zip-top plastic bag and seal. Place bag on top of pickles ensuring all of them are completely submerged in brine. Store in cool, dry place, OR if using a fermentation jar, fill airlock and secure lid.
Check ferment every day. Fermentation has begun if you see bubbles rising to top of crock. Skim off any scum that forms. If scum forms on plastic bag, rinse it off and return to top of crock.

Fermentation is complete when pickles taste sour and bubbles have stopped rising; this should take approximately 6 to 7 days. Once this happens, cover the crock loosely and place in refrigerator for 3 days, skimming daily or as needed.
Store for up to 2 months in refrigerator.

recipes.name: DIPPING SAUCE
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

recipes.name: Fig-Thyme Preserves (for Portobello Mousse)
instructions: Combine figs, thyme, apple juice, salt, pepper, and apple cider vinegar in 2-quart saucepan.
Bring mixture to simmer and cook for 20 minutes with lid slightly ajar.
Use immersion blender to roughly puree mixture slightly (mixture can be chunky).
Chill preserves before serving.
Serve fig-thyme preserves with Portobello mousse and sliced baguette (see previous recipe).

recipes.name: FISH CONGEE
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine water, white basmati rice, long grain brown rice, and salt. Bring to boil for 2-3 minutes. Add burdock, carrot, and onion. Lower flame, cover and allow to simmer, stirring frequently, until rice is creamy and lightly thickened (1 to 1 1/2 hours).
Cut fillet in 2-inch pieces. Add to soup 3 minutes before end of cooking, or until just tender.
Turn off flame; add toasted sesame oil, tamari, and scallions.
Ladle into bowls; garnish with nori strips.
Note: Scissors work best for cutting the nori.

recipes.name: Fresh Curry Sauce
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk with cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cloves, cardamom pods, shallots, jalapeno, turmeric, and salt. Simmer on low flame 15-20 minutes or until sauce is thickened to nappé consistency. Do not allow sauce to boil at any time.
Strain vegetables and spices from sauce, and return sauce to pot.
Add ginger and lime juices. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Fresh Herb Marinade
instructions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients.
Let vegetables soak in marinade for 20 to 30 minutes before grilling.

recipes.name: Fresh Ketchup (for Red Lentil and Toasted Sunflower Burger)
instructions: Combine onion and vegetable stock in 2-quart sauce pot. Bring mixture to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook for 15 minutes or until onion mixture is soft and reduced to 1/3 cup.
Add remaining ingredients to pot and simmer for 10 minutes more. Refrigerate.

recipes.name: FRESH TOMATO SAUCE
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan combine oil, garlic, basil and tomatoes.
Cook over medium heat 25 to 35 minutes until tomatoes have released their juices and water has cooked out.
Add salt and black pepper to taste. You can puree sauce in blender, or serve it as is.

recipes.name: Fried Calamari
instructions: In small mixing bowl, combine salt, pepper and flour.
In wok, heat oil to 350°F-375°F.
Dredge squid in flour mixture, coating well. Shake off excess flour.
Deep-fry squid in small batches until golden (this helps to maintain constant oil temperature to produce crispy squid).
Drain fried calamari on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt; garnish with mint and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Fried Shrimp with Wasabi Garnish
recipes.description: (Year-Round)
instructions: In food processor, combine shrimp, garlic, miso, tamari, curry powder, and salt. Process to smooth paste. Add 1 tablespoon of chives and pulse once or twice until incorporated into mixture. Transfer mixture from processor to small bowl.
Using 1-ounce scoop, portion shrimp balls and roll in breadcrumbs.
Refrigerate breaded shrimp for 20-30 minutes.
Heat oil in wok to 350°F. Deep fry shrimp until golden. Drain shrimp on paper towels.
In small bowl, mix wasabi powder with water and juice. Add enough liquid to achieve smooth, pipe-able consistency. Transfer mixture to small pastry bag with small round tip.
Sprinkle shrimp with salt and a squeeze of lemon juice. Skewer shrimp with toothpick and garnish with small dab of wasabi paste and remaining 1 tablespoon of chives. Garnish tray with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: FRISEE SALAD WITH GRILLED BABY CARROTS, CUCUMBER, AND RADISHES WITH AVOCADO DRESSING
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: Toss carrots in bowl with olive oil and salt. Heat grill. Grill carrots until grill marks are visible. Set aside.
In medium bowl, combine radishes, cucumber, frisee, and jalapeno.
Pour lime juice over avocado slices and set aside.
Combine dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Toss salad with dressing. Garnish with carrots and avocado slices.

recipes.name: Ginger Marinade
instructions: Combine ingredients in blender and puree.

recipes.name: GLAZED SEITAN STIR FRY

ingredients.name: arrowroot dissolved in 2 tablespoons cold water

instructions: In wok, heat oil over medium-high flame. Add seitan and stir-fry until caramelized.

Add onions and stir-fry until lightly caramelized. Add carrots and continue stir-frying until carrots are just tender. Add garlic, ginger, snow peas, and red pepper flakes. Continue to stir-fry until all vegetables are tender but crisp.
In small bowl, combine all glaze ingredients and whisk to combine. Pour glaze over vegetables and seitan. Mix to combine, cooking until mixture thickens and all ingredients are evenly coated.
Drizzle with toasted sesame oil and garnish with cashews and scallions.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE GREEN OLIVE-PARMESAN BREAD
instructions: Preheat oven to 325° F.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda in one bowl.
In separate bowl, whisk together egg, buttermilk and melted butter.
Mix wet into dry until just combined. Add olives and parmesan.
Pour batter into muffin molds.
Bake for 30-45 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in bread comes out clean.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE IRISH SODA BREAD
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and maple crystals.
In separate bowl, combine butter, eggs, and buttermilk and beat to combine well. Add raisins.
Create well in center of dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and egg mixture and mix gently to combine. Transfer dough to muffin molds.

Bake bread about 30-40 minutes, or until golden in color and toothpick inserted in quick bread comes out clean. Remove from oven, and allow bread to cool in muffin forms for 10 minutes before inverting finished bread onto cooling rack.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE MINI PIZZAS
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet trays with Silpats or parchment generously brushed with olive oil.
In small bowl, dissolve maple crystals in water and add yeast. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside.
In separate small bowl, whisk together rice flour, tapioca flour, xanthan gum, fennel, and salt. Set aside.
In stand mixer, blend egg, 1 tablespoon of oil, and yeast-maple crystal water. Add flour mix and beat on high for 2 minutes.
Using tablespoon, spoon batter onto cookie sheet, making 6-8 pizzas per sheet. With circular motion, spread each circle out with spoon to about 2 inches in diameter.
Cover with inverted baking sheet, and let rise 40-45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375° F.
Bake each mini pizza 10 minutes without toppings.
Remove trays from oven, and garnish pizzas with toppings of choice. Dribble remaining oil over each mini pizza. Bake another 10 minutes to cook fillings and melt cheese, if using.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE PEAR-CARDAMOM QUICK BREAD
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and cardamom.
In separate bowl, whisk together egg, maple crystals, canola oil, and vanilla extract. Add wet ingredients to dry and stir to combine. Add pears and walnuts and divide batter between muffin molds.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to wire rack to finish cooling.

recipes.name: Gravad Lax

ingredients.name: boneless salmon or arctic char filet

instructions: Score salmon by making two, 2-3-inch-long and 1/4 inch deep cuts into each side of fish.
Transfer salmon to shallow pan skin side down.
In bowl, mix all remaining ingredients.
Place mixture directly over salmon, packing ingredients down.

Wrap salmon tightly in plastic and refrigerate for 3 days to cure. After end of each day, drain any liquid that has been extracted from salmon. If necessary, add another cup of maple crystals and sea salt to salmon.
On last day, rinse off salmon. Color of flesh should have darkened, and texture should be firmer.

recipes.name: GREAT NORTHERN BEAN AND ROASTED GARLIC PURÉE
instructions: Combine beans in pressure cooker with salt, thyme, and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover by 1 inch. Cover and bring to full pressure. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid and drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.
Discard thyme stems and bay leaf and transfer beans to food processor.
Add lemon, garlic, and olive oil. Puree until smooth, adding bean liquid as necessary to form smooth, thick purée.
Transfer to bowl season to taste and fold in parsley, dill, salt, and pepper. Serve on toasted baguette.

recipes.name: Green Bean and Walnut Pâté

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 1-gallon pot, bring 3 quarts of water to boil with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Add green beans and blanch until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Shock beans in ice water and drain in colander. Slice 8 beans thinly on diagonal for garnish. Cut remaining beans into 1-inch pieces. Set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Cover and sweat onions over low heat until very soft, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover pan and continue cooking and stirring often until onions are caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add wine to onions and continue cooking until wine is reduced and mixture is almost dry.
Puree 1 cup of walnuts with green beans, onions, miso, and vinegar in food processor until smooth. Season to taste. Chop remaining 1/4 cup of walnuts for garnish.
Present pâté garnished with string beans and chopped walnuts.

recipes.name: GREEN LENTIL TERRINE

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 2 tablespoons warm water
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line terrine mold with parchment.

In 1-gallon pot, combine lentils, salt, vegetable stock, and bay leaves. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat, and simmer for 30-40 minutes or until lentils are tender. Drain lentils in colander for 10 minutes.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions until browned. Add thyme, coriander, and nutmeg. Sauté 2 minutes more. Set aside.
Transfer lentils to food processor and pulse to form thick paste.

Transfer lentils to medium-size bowl. Add onions, 1 cup bread crumbs, parsley, miso, and tahini. Mixture should be thick but moist. If mixture is too loose, add more bread crumbs. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into terrine mold and bake until firm, about 20 to 25 minutes. Chill terrine until it reaches room temperature, about 1 hour.

recipes.name: GREENS WITH CUCUMBER ICE AND LIME VINAIGRETTE
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, heat lime juice and rice syrup over medium heat until syrup has dissolved.
Puree cucumber in Vitamix with rice syrup-lime juice mixture, salt, and mint. Blend until smooth.
Transfer mixture to ice cream maker and process until frozen. Set aside in freezer.
In small bowl, combine dressing ingredients – lime juice, rice syrup, salt, and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until dressing emulsifies.
Arrange salad greens on plate. Scoop cucumber ice into center. Drizzle with dressing. Garnish with tomatoes, avocado, cilantro, and mint leaves.

recipes.name: GRILLED PINEAPPLE CHUTNEY
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil and sweat onion until translucent.

While onion is cooking, roast red pepper over open flame. When skin is blackened, place in paper bag for 10 minutes. Remove from bag, let cool and remove blackened skin. Cut pepper into small dice and add to pan with red onion.
Add jalapeño to onion and pepper mixture. Cook 5 minutes more and set pan aside.
Peel and cut pineapple into 4 wedges of equal size. Grill slices and set aside. When slices are cool, cut into medium-small dice and add to onion and pepper mixture.
Season with salt and lime juice and garnish with minced cilantro.

recipes.name: HANDMADE GARLIC MAYONNAISE
instructions: Smash garlic with salt to paste on cutting board.
Put garlic paste in bowl together with egg yolks and mustard; whisk until smooth.
Slowly add oil (no more than one teaspoon at a time) to egg yolk mixture, whisking until well incorporated before adding more oil.
As mixture begins to thicken, oil can be added somewhat more rapidly (no more than one tablespoon at a time).
When all oil has been incorporated, whisk in lemon juice.

Note: If using extra virgin oil, use mild-flavored oil. Most Italian olive oils have too robust a flavor and leave bitter aftertaste on tongue. It is also helpful to use relatively small proportion of oil to egg yolk.

recipes.name: HASHED BRUSSEL SPROUTS WITH CARROTS AND POPPY SEEDS
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)
instructions: In large bowl toss Brussels sprouts with lemon juice.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add carrots and sauté for about 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon of wine, lower heat and continue to cook until carrots are bright orange but still crunchy.
Add Brussels sprouts, garlic, poppy seeds and remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Add remaining 3 tablespoons of wine. Cook until Brussels sprouts are tender (about 3-4 minutes).
Warm right before service and add salt and pepper. Add parsley just before service.

recipes.name: HERB MARINADE
instructions: In small saucepan, warm all ingredients in oil and remove from heat. Cool marinade before use.

recipes.name: HERBED DINNER ROLLS

ingredients.name: chopped fresh thyme or other herbs
olive oil or rice syrup diluted with water

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In large bowl, combine water, yeast, maple syrup, white high-gluten flour, and 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour. Stir until thick batter forms. Cover sponge with plastic wrap and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes or until foamy and doubled in size.
Add oil, salt, and thyme to sponge and stir to combine. Add remaining whole wheat pastry flour and just enough all-purpose flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.

Knead dough with remaining flour for about 10-15 minutes or until smooth dough has been created. Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
Fold and turn dough. Rise again. Divide dough into 1-ounce balls.
Form dough into dinner roll shapes (see diagrams following) and transfer rolls to parchment-lined sheet trays. Cover with damp towel and set aside to rise for 10-15 minutes more.
Lightly brush tops of rolls with olive oil or egg wash. Sprinkle sesame seeds or poppy seeds on top.
Bake 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden and firm to touch.
Remove from sheet trays and cool on racks before serving.

recipes.name: HIGH-PROTEIN GLUTEN-FREE FLOUR MIX
instructions: Note: for this recipe use 1 3/4 cups flour (discard extra tablespoon).

recipes.name: HIZIKI CAVIAR
instructions: Sauté hiziki in medium pan with 2 tablespoons sesame oil for 3 minutes. Add water to cover, bring to boil, add shoyu and cook uncovered until all liquid is evaporated, about 15 minutes.
Sauté shallots and garlic in separate medium sauté pan with remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Finely chop the hiziki while shallots and garlic are sautéing. Combine hiziki with cooked shallot-garlic mixture in small bowl.
Season with additional sea salt, if needed. Add lemon juice and ginger juice to taste. Serve on bread, pita, toast points, or crackers. Garnish with tofu sour cream.

recipes.name: HIZIKI WITH CARROTS, ONIONS, AND AGÉ TOFU
instructions: Heat oil to 375°F in 2 1/2 quart pot. Line plate with paper towel. Fry tofu in batches until golden. Drain on paper towel.
Combine hiziki in separate 2 1/2 quart pot with apple juice and water. Bring to boil. Add carrots, onion, fried tofu, toasted sesame oil, and shoyu. Simmer 30 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Garnish with sesame seeds before serving.

recipes.name: Hollandaise
instructions: Using round-bottomed, straight-sided bowl over bain marie (double boiler), whisk yolks with lemon juice, salt and pepper until thick and creamy – until whisk leaves tracks in yolks.
Have butter warm but not hot. Add butter slowly, drop by drop first, whisking continuously.
Do not add more than egg yolks can hold. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
If sauce breaks, rescue by adding 1 teaspoon of cold water and beating vigorously. If this does not work, whisk 2 egg yolks into broken sauce as you would butter.
If necessary, thin with few drops of warm water.

recipes.name: HONEY-MUSTARD YOGURT
instructions: In small bowl, whisk all ingredients together.

recipes.name: HORSERADISH AND LEMON CONDIMENT
instructions: Grate horseradish on box grater using fine holes.
Combine horseradish with lemon juice and set aside for ten minutes at room temperature.
Serve cold or room temperature mixed into water, stock or soup.

recipes.name: HOT WINGS WITH STILTON-YOGURT DRESSING
instructions: Preheat convection oven to 400°F.
In medium bowl, combine flour, paprika, garlic powder, thyme, pepper, cayenne, and salt.
Toss wings in canola oil, then flour-spice mixture, and shake off excess.
Transfer wings to baker’s rack atop half sheet tray and roast for 15 minutes. Flip wings and roast an additional 15 minutes.
Melt butter and combine with Tabasco and maple syrup in medium bowl.
Add cooked wings to hot sauce-butter mixture and toss to coat.
Combine strained yogurt and cheese. Mix thoroughly. Serve with wings.

recipes.name: ICHIBAN DASHI
recipes.description: Traditional Japanese Broth
instructions: Wipe kombu with towel, if it has salty residue. Place it in pot and cover with cold water. Let stand 30 minutes.
Bring to boil, add bonito flakes and remove from heat.
Wait till bonito flakes sink to bottom of pot and strain through cheesecloth.
Note: Kombu and bonito flakes can be re-used once: just simmer 4-5 minutes and discard. This is called niban-dashi.

recipes.name: Jerk Seitan Sloppy Joe's
instructions: In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil on medium-high flame. Add onions and sauté until slightly caramelized.
Add seitan and sauté until caramelized, lower heat, and add garlic, thyme, paprika, salt, allspice, red pepper flakes, cinnamon, and black pepper. Sweat until onions are tender.
Add tomatoes, maple syrup, and mustard. Simmer 5-10 minutes or until desired 'stewy' consistency.
Season to taste with lime and ginger juices.
Heat cast iron pan or griddle on medium-low flame. Place tortillas on pan or griddle and heat until softened and flexible.
Dollop 1/4 cup of seitan mixture into each tortilla. Garnish with 1 slice of avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Kabocha Salad
recipes.description: (Fall/Winter)
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Toss squash with oil, salt, and pepper in medium-size bowl. Arrange squash on parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and tender. Remove from oven and set aside.
Toss pumpkin seeds in small bowl with cumin, salt, ginger, and oil. Bake in oven until seeds are lightly toasted, 5-7 minutes.
Combine all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy. Toss arugula with dressing.
Place about 3/4 cup of squash on plate.
Arrange arugula on atop or alongside squash. Garnish arugula with nuts, pomegranate seeds and feta.

recipes.name: KASHA (for loaf)
instructions: In small pot, combine kasha, salt and water.
Bring to boil, immediately turn off heat, and let sit (with lid on) until all water is absorbed (approximately 10 minutes).

recipes.name: Kasha-Potato Loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In small pot, combine kasha with boiling water with salt; cover pot. Bring back to a rolling boil; turn off heat and let sit (with lid on) for 15 minutes.

In medium pot, cover potatoes with enough water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to boil, covered. Lower heat and simmer until tender, but not mushy, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash potatoes coarsely; set aside.
In 10-inch sauté pan, caramelize onions in olive oil until dark brown, adding celery in last few minutes of cooking along with salt, thyme and sage.
Roast caraway seeds over medium heat in small sauté pan, until fragrant, about 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In medium bowl, mix kasha with potatoes, onion mixture, caraway seeds and shoyu. Season to taste with pepper and more salt (or shoyu) if desired.
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper and fill with kasha-potato mixture, packing tightly.
Bake until warmed through, about 20 minutes.
Let cool to room temperature before removing from pan. Slice and serve.

recipes.name: Ketchup (for Tempeh Reuben Sandwich)
instructions: In blender, combine raisins (with soaking liquid), tomato puree, garlic, water, paprika, cayenne, cinnamon, and salt. Blend until all ingredients are combined.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, on high heat, heat oil. Slowly add tomato mixture. Lower heat and simmer 40 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer 5 minutes more. Adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: KIDNEY BEAN SALAD
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)
instructions: Combine beans with water and bring to boil over high heat. Add pinch of sea salt.
Lower heat and simmer until beans are tender (about 45 to 60 minutes). Drain beans.
Whisk together mustard, lime juice, apple cider vinegar, and salt. Slowly whisk in olive oil. Pour dressing over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with radishes, scallions and parsley.

recipes.name: Lemon and Maple-Flavored Yogurt
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in small bowl.

recipes.name: Lemon-Dill Mayonnaise (for Poached Salmon)
recipes.description: Fall/Winter
instructions: Whisk together egg yolk, mustard, lemon juice, water and salt in bowl.

Drop by drop add oil, whisking constantly. When half the oil is used up, mayonnaise will be thick enough to add remainder about one tablespoon at a time, until it’s all used up. Add lemon zest. Refrigerate.

recipes.name: Long Grain Brown Rice
instructions: Dry roast until rice in small pot until dry and slightly aromatic.
Add boiling water and salt to rice. Cover. Bring back to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 30 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove pot from heat and let steam 10 to 15 minutes covered.

recipes.name: MANGO PUREE
instructions: Puree mango, lime juice, and agave nectar in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: MANGO SALSA FOR CRUSTED FLOUNDER
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve atop crusted flounder.

recipes.name: Massaged Kale Salad with Roasted Chickpeas and Pickled Red Onion
recipes.description: (Fall/Winter)
instructions: Combine chickpeas in pressure cooker with salt, bay leaf, and thyme sprigs. Add water to cover by 2 inches. Bring pot to pressure, lower heat, and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid. Drain beans.
Heat oven to 350°F. Combine and toss chickpeas in medium bowl with olive oil, fennel, cumin, paprika, pepper flakes, and additional salt to taste.
Transfer chickpeas to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast until crispy, around 15 minutes. Set aside.
Combine red onions in medium bowl with boiling water and let sit 5-10 minutes. Drain. Add vinegar, salt, and agave. Mix to combine.
Combine kale in medium bowl with salt, lemon zest and lemon juice. Massage with gloved hands until moisture is released and kale begins to soften in texture.
Mix kale with chickpeas and olives. Garnish with pickled onions.

recipes.name: MEDITERRANEAN-INSPIRED PASTA SALAD
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Set aside.
Heat oven to 350°F.
Toss eggplant in bowl with olive oil and salt. Transfer to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast in oven until eggplant is tender (about 20 minutes). Set aside.
Bring 1-gallon pot of salted water to boil. Add broccoli rabe and blanch about 2-3 minutes. Shock in ice water. Wring excess moisture from broccoli rabe and add to bowl with dressing.
In same pot, boil pasta for 8-10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and transfer to bowl with dressing and broccoli rabe; toss to combine.
Add eggplant, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, pine nuts, currants, and basil to pasta, broccoli rabe, and dressing. Toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve at room temperature.

recipes.name: Miso Marinade
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until smooth and well mixed.

recipes.name: Mornay Sauce
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, over low flame, add onion piqué to milk. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid scorching.
Remove piqué onion from pot. Set milk aside to cool.
In 10-inch sauté pan, combine flour and butter. Stir with wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes. Let roux cool.
Slowly and gradually whisk cooled milk into warm roux.
Simmer sauce for approximately 20-30 minutes until thickened and reduced to nappé consistency.
Strain sauce through fine chinois.
Add cheese and whisk until cheese is totally melted and incorporated into sauce.
Note: Piqué is a bay leaf tacked with whole clove to peeled halved onion.

recipes.name: MUHAMMARA
instructions: Combine peppers, garlic, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, and walnuts in bowl of food processor and puree.
Add breadcrumbs, black pepper, olive oil, vegetable stock, and sherry vinegar. Puree until smooth. Serve with Mediterranean Roasted Black Cod.

recipes.name: Mushroom Consommé
instructions: Combine shiitakes, porcinis, and kombu with water in 2-gallon pot. Simmer stock 20 minutes, strain and reserve stock, discarding mushrooms and kombu.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Toss onion, carrot and fennel with oil. Roast vegetables until well caramelized, approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Add tomatoes and garlic for last 10 minutes.
In 12-inch sauté pan, sauté button mushrooms in oil until well caramelized, stirring often. Deglaze pan over high heat with some reserved stock.

Transfer sautéed mushrooms, their deglazing liquid, and roasted vegetables to 1-gallon pot. Add bouquet garni and remaining stock. Simmer 45 minutes, skimming surface. Strain and reserve broth, discarding bouquet garni and vegetables.
In 1-gallon pot, reduce broth to about 8 cups. Chill broth in ice bath to room temperature.

Add clarification to pot, mixing well. Heat broth to simmer, stirring occasionally. When simmer is reached, cease stirring. Clarification will rise to top, forming “raft.” Simmer uncovered another 20 minutes. Strain resulting “consommé” (clarified broth) through chinois lined with many layers of cheesecloth.
Degrease surface of consommé with paper towels, if necessary. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle soup in bowls and garnish with chives.

recipes.name: MUSHROOM SAUCE

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions, carrots and celery until golden.
Add tomatoes and sauté for few minutes or until slightly caramelized.
Add 6 cups stock and bring to boil. Lower heat to simmer.
Slowly whisk remaining 1 cup of stock to cooled roux.
Slowly add roux-stock mixture back into sauce.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat, add mushrooms and sweat until tender.
Add mushrooms to pot and simmer uncovered, about 30 minutes, or until reduced by half and nappé consistency is achieved.
Strain through chinois and return to pot.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: Mushroom-Walnut Pâté
instructions: Combine dried porcini mushrooms with boiling water in small bowl. Soak until mushrooms are soft and pliable, about 20 to 30 minutes. Strain mixture through chinois. Set aside mushrooms and reserve 6 tablespoons soaking liquid.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over low heat. Sweat onion until translucent. Add garlic and continue sweating, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and evenly browned, about 15 minutes. Add minced sage and cook 1 minute more. Transfer onion-garlic mixture from pan to bowl and set aside.

Add another tablespoon olive oil to same pan, raise heat, and sear mushrooms in batches, making sure that they are in one, even layer in pan. Add more oil as necessary between batches. Add seared mushrooms to bowl with onion-garlic mixture.
Deglaze pan with sherry. Reduce sherry to about 1/4 cup.

In food processor, combine garlic-onion-mushroom mixture, deglazing liquid, 1 cup of walnuts, porcini soaking liquid, and balsamic vinegar. Pulse to thick, spreadable consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

In 8-inch sauté pan, heat canola oil over medium-high flame. Toss sage leaves with arrowroot. Fry dusted sage leaves for a few seconds in oil until crisp. Transfer leaves from pan to plate lined with paper towel to drain.
Chop remaining 2 tablespoon of walnuts to use as garnish with parsley and fried sage leaves.

recipes.name: MUSHROOMS A LA GRECQUE
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)

ingredients.name: drizzle of extra virgin olive oil

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine mushrooms, wine, lemon peel, lemon juice, olive oil, fennel seeds, garlic, thyme sprigs, salt, pepper, and water.
Bring mixture to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for about 5-7 minutes.

Remove lemon peel, thyme sprigs, and smashed garlic. Remove mushrooms from pot with slotted spoon. Serve mushrooms atop mesclun, garnished with tarragon. Drizzle small amount of cooled cooking liquid over salad just before serving.

recipes.name: NIÇOISE SALAD
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Season to taste. Set aside.

Heat oven to 350°F. Combine potatoes in medium bowl and toss with 1 teaspoon of salt and olive oil. Transfer to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast until golden and tender. Toss with 2-3 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 6 cups of water to boil. Add haricots verts and remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt and blanch until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Shock in ice cold water. Drain for a few minutes in colander. Cut haricots verts in half lengthwise and toss with 2-3 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

Combine eggs in 2 1/2 quart pot with water to cover by one inch. Cover pot, bring to boil, and remove pot from heat. Allow eggs to remain in hot water for 10 minutes. Shock eggs in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and slice each egg into 4 wedges. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

Heat cast iron grill pan. Drizzle fish with olive oil and season with salt. Grill fish on each side for about 1-2 minutes, depending on thickness of fish. Remove fish from grill. Let fish rest about 7-10 minutes before slicing into 1/4-inch slices.
Pour remaining 1/4 cup of dressing over lettuce and mix to combine. Arrange potatoes, haricots verts, eggs, sliced fish, tomatoes, and olives on mound of dressed greens. Garnish with capers.

recipes.name: NORI CONDIMENT
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan, add nori, water, shoyu, and rice syrup.
Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, and stir often. Let simmer until all the liquid is absorbed.
Serve as condiment on grains or beans.

recipes.name: NORI ROLLS
instructions: Combine rice, water, and pinch of salt in small pressure cooker. Bring pot to full pressure, reduce heat, and cook at low pressure for 35 minutes. Turn off heat, remove pressure cooker from stove, and steam rice, covered, for 15 minutes.
Transfer rice from pot to large bowl. While rice is still hot, add seasoning mixture and stir with spatula. Cover bowl with damp towel and allow rice to rest for 10 minutes.

Place nori sheet on near edge of sushi mat, shiny side down. Have small bowl of water nearby to moisten fingers. Transfer 3/4 cup of rice to nori sheet and spread evenly with wet fingertips, leaving two-inch strip at far edge of nori bare.

Using chopstick or spoon, spread separate, thin, horizontal lines of wasabi and umeboshi paste across the rice at near end of nori sheet. Arrange slices of avocado, carrot, and scallions lengthwise on top of paste.

Bring near edge of nori and mat up and snugly over arranged vegetables, in rolling motion. Continue rolling forward, withdrawing mat as you go. Moisten strip of nori at far end of roll with wet fingertips. Continue to roll forward to seal roll.

recipes.name: OATMEAL DULSE CRACKERS
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)

ingredients.name: sea seasonings dulse granules with garlic

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In food processor, finely grind oats, sunflower seeds, and flour together. Add dulse granules and salt.
In separate small bowl, whisk together coconut oil and rice syrup.
Add oil-syrup mixture to dry ingredients in food processor, adding in water as needed. (Dough should be stiff, yet pliable.)
Between parchments sheets, roll out dough with rolling pin to uniform thickness, 1/8 inch. Remove top sheet of parchment.
Mix together equal amounts of sesame, poppy and caraway seeds and sprinkle liberally over rolled dough. Cover with top sheet of parchment again and roll seeds into dough.

Remove top sheet of parchment again. Score dough all the way through using pizza cutter or knife at 2-inch intervals vertically and horizontally to create squares. Score diagonally to make triangles. Slide dough with bottom parchment onto half sheet pan.
Bake until lightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes. (Caution: crackers on outer edges may brown more quickly than those in center.)

recipes.name: OLIVE TAPENADE
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and blend until smooth. Stop now and again to scrape down sides with spoon or spatula.

recipes.name: Orange-Miso Barbecue Sauce
instructions: In small pot combine rice syrup, tomato paste, mustard, miso, vinegar, zest and juice. Cook for approximately 5 minutes.
In small bowl, dissolve kuzu in 2 tablespoons of water; then add enough water to make 1 cup.
Pour kuzu mixture into saucepan and heat slowly, stirring with whisk to prevent lumping. Add salt.
Simmer 5 minutes and adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: PEANUT SAUCE
instructions: Puree peanuts and water in VitaMix to paste consistency. Add garlic, tamari, oil, sugar, lime juice, cayenne, coconut milk, and maple syrup. Puree until smooth. Add salt to taste.

recipes.name: PESTO (CILANTRO-PUMPKIN SEED)
instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add cilantro and pinch of salt. Blanch cilantro 2-3 seconds. Shock cilantro in ice bath, drain, and squeeze out excess moisture. Set aside.
Combine and puree pumpkin seeds, garlic, cilantro, umeboshi paste, and miso in food processor.
Through feed tube, add oil slowly and puree until well combined (20-30 seconds).

recipes.name: PINE NUT RICOTTA ON TREVISO LEAVES
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)

ingredients.name: pinch of sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In food processor, puree pine nuts, garlic paste, oil, miso, lemon juice, and umeboshi paste. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer mixture to medium bowl or pastry bag with round tip.
Dollop or pipe 1 heaping tablespoon of nut filling in each Treviso leaf and garnish with chives, yellow and red peppers, and pine nuts.

recipes.name: PITA
instructions: Preheat convection oven to 400°F with a pizza stone inside. In bowl, combine water, maple syrup, and yeast. Proof for about 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.
Add oil, salt, all-purpose flour, bread flour, and enough whole wheat pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough about 10-15 minutes, using remaining pastry flour, until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for approximately 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare 6 pizza peels dusted with cornmeal or semolina.
Fold/turn dough. Rise dough again.
Divide dough into 16 equal-sized balls. Using rolling pin, roll each ball of dough into 1/8-inch thick, 6-inch circle and transfer to pizza peels.
Loosely cover dough with damp towels and set aside in warm place. Rise for about 15 minutes.
Bake pita for approximately 3-4 minutes or until puffed. Don’t let pita brown, as that makes them too crisp.

recipes.name: POACHED CHICKEN AND ROASTED ASPARAGUS
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, 1/4 teaspoon curry powder, and pepper. Transfer asparagus to parchment-lined half sheet pan. Roast until just tender and slightly browned. Set aside.

In 1-gallon pot, bring poach ingredients – chicken stock, coconut milk, bay leaves, thyme, cilantro, salt, remaining 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, and pepper – to simmer. Add chicken, lower heat, cover pot, and poach 15 minutes or until chicken is tender and flesh is opaque.
Remove pot from heat; let chicken remain in stock 20 to 25 minutes. Remove chicken from stock, cool, and cut into 1/3-inch thick diagonal slices. Set aside.
In blender, combine dressing ingredients until creamy. Drain fennel and toss with 2-3 tablespoons of dressing.
On large plate, arrange mesclun, poached chicken, fennel, endive, onion, and asparagus. Drizzle dressing over salad ingredients and chicken. Garnish with cilantro.
Seasonal variation: In Fall/Winter, substitute 1 small head of cauliflower for asparagus.

recipes.name: Poached Shrimp
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and add shrimp. Poach for 4-5 minutes and remove with spider.
Cool shrimp in ice bath. Remove and place on serving platter with Cocktail Sauce.

recipes.name: Polenta, Goat Cheese, and Black Bean Terrine
instructions: Combine beans in small pressure cooker with water, bay leaves, garlic, and salt. Bring to pressure, lower heat, and cook 15 minutes. Bring down pressure, remove bay leaf, and drain beans in colander. Transfer beans to food processor.

Melt butter in 8-inch sauté pan over low flame. Add cumin, salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, basil, and cayenne. When spices are fragrant (30 seconds), add them to beans. Puree beans in food processor. Stiffen mixture with breadcrumbs if needed to create texture in which spoon will stand.

In 2-quart saucepan, bring water and salt to boil. Slowly whisk in polenta. Exchange whisk for spoon and cook another 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Add in butter, coriander, white pepper, and cayenne and cook 5 minutes more. Adjust seasonings.
Line loaf pan with parchment paper.

Pour two-thirds polenta into terrine mold. Fold goat cheese and cilantro into remaining one-third polenta. Spread in mold as second layer. Spread bean puree in mold as third layer. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, about 1 hour.
Garnish with cilantro sprigs. Serve with crackers and roasted red pepper puree.

recipes.name: POMEGRANATE REDUCTION
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2 quart pot. Simmer until thickened to nappé consistency.

recipes.name: PORCINI MUSHROOM STOCK
instructions: Heat oil in 1-gallon stockpot. Add fresh mushrooms and onion to cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until well browned, about 15 minutes.
Add water, garlic, porcini mushrooms, reserved soaking water, celery, carrots, bay leaves, peppercorns, parsley stems, and thyme and bring to boil, covered.
Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove dried mushrooms and discard or save for another use.
Strain stock through double layer of cheesecloth. Press vegetables firmly to get out as much liquid as possible.
Measure volume of stock. Return to stove and reduce to 3 cups.

recipes.name: PRESSED NUT CRUST

ingredients.name: canola oil or 2 tablespoons melted coconut oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil 9-inch pie or tart pan.
Grind almonds in food processor to form fine almond meal.
Grind oats coarsely in food processor.
In medium bowl, combine almonds, oats, oat flour, cinnamon and salt; mix well.
In separate bowl, whisk together maple syrup, and canola or melted coconut oil.
Mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients.
With wet fingertips, press crust into oiled pie or tart pan.
Bake crust 20 to 25 minutes or until golden and completely baked.

recipes.name: PROCEDURE FOR EGG-THICKENED SAUCES - HOLLANDAISE
instructions: Using round-bottomed, straight-sided bowl over bain marie (double boiler), whisk yolks with lemon juice, salt and pepper until thick and creamy – until whisk leaves tracks in yolks.
Have butter warm but not hot. Add butter slowly, drop by drop first, whisking continuously.
Do not add more than egg yolks can hold. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
If sauce breaks, rescue by adding 1 teaspoon of cold water and beating vigorously. If this does not work, whisk 2 egg yolks into broken sauce as you would butter.
If necessary, thin with few drops of warm water.

recipes.name: RASPBERRY PUREE
instructions: Puree raspberries and maple syrup in blender until smooth. Strain puree to remove seeds.

recipes.name: RAW JERUSALEM ARTICHOKE SALAD
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)
instructions: Combine all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Combine Jerusalem artichokes and radishes in small bowl with half the dressing. Marinate 30 minutes.
Dress chicory with remaining dressing.
Toss chicory with Jerusalem artichokes and radishes.

recipes.name: Red Cabbage-Caraway Sauerkraut
instructions: Place cabbage in large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Squeeze and massage cabbage to release water. Continue to massage and squeeze until enough liquid has been released to create salty brine that covers cabbage by 1/4 inch. Add caraway seeds.

Pack tightly into 2 quart wide-mouthed glass jar or ceramic crock (liquid brine must be above cabbage for healthy successful fermentation). If cabbage has not released enough juices to cover, add salted water to jar/crock in a ratio of 1 teaspoon sea salt per 1 cup water.

Place plate or discover cabbage and press down to squeeze more brine to surface. Cover mouth of vessel with cheesecloth and secure to rim of lid with kitchen twine, rubber band, OR if using airlock lid, fill airlock and secure lid.

Store sauerkraut in dry place for 2 - 4 weeks at room temperature. Be sure to check water level, adding more salt water as needed to ensure the mixture is covered throughout fermentation process. Taste every few days and eat or refrigerate when desired tangy flavor is achieved.
Note: A cooler fermentation area will result in a slower fermentation with complex flavor notes. A warmer area will result in a faster fermentation that may lead to off flavors and cloudy brine.

recipes.name: RED LENTIL PÂTÉ
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 1 tablespoon water

instructions: Combine lentils in 2 1/2 quart pot with water or stock, bring to boil, and simmer covered 20 minutes.
Heat oil in 8-inch sauté pan. Add onions, garlic, and herbs and cook until caramelized.
Oil and line loaf pan with parchment and sprinkle with half the breadcrumbs.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
When lentils are cooked, mash by stirring, add onion mixture, remaining breadcrumbs, and parsley. Season with black pepper, umeboshi vinegar, and white miso.
Fold pâté into pan and bake 20-30 minutes. Allow to set, cool, and slice. Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: RED LENTIL TERRINE

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 3 tablespoons warm water
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line terrine mold with parchment paper and set aside.

In 1-gallon pot, combine lentils, stock, salt, and bay leaf. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer until lentils are tender, about half an hour. Drain lentils in colander for 10 minutes, transfer to medium bowl, and set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame and sweat onions and garlic until translucent. Continue to sweat, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and uniformly browned, about 15 minutes.
Deglaze pan with mirin. Combine onions with lentils. Add walnuts, umeboshi paste, miso, salt, pepper, cilantro, and parsley. Mix to combine. Season to taste.
Fold mixture into terrine mold. Bake until firm, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Refrigerate terrine until it sets, about 1 hour.

recipes.name: RED WINE MARINADE
instructions: In blender, combine wine, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper and thyme.

recipes.name: Refried Soba with Vegetables
instructions: Heat large wok; add sesame oil, ginger and garlic. Cook 1 minute.
Add bok choy stems, then add leaves, red pepper and scallions. Cook until pepper is just tender. Add sprouts and jalapeno.
Add shoyu and toasted sesame oil. Season with salt to taste. Add noodles. Mix well and serve.

recipes.name: ROASTED DULSE CONDIMENT
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place dulse on half sheet pan with parchment and bake for 10 minutes.
Combine toasted sesame seeds with roasted dulse in suribachi and grind until most of seeds are broken.
Serve as a condiment over cooked millet.
Store excess in air-tight glass container.

recipes.name: ROASTED GARLIC SAUCE

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Roast garlic (wrapped in foil) in 400°F oven for approximately 35 minutes. When cool, squeeze out garlic paste from skin. Blend with small amount of stock until consistency is creamy.
In 1-gallon pot, over medium-high flame, heat remaining tablespoon oil. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until lightly caramelized.
Deglaze over high heat with red wine and brown rice vinegar. Reduce liquid until almost dry (au sec).
Add 3 1/2 cups stock, sachet d'epices, and mushrooms. Cover sauce and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 to 20 minutes. Skim occasionally. Discard sachet.
In small bowl, whisk remaining 1/2 cup stock to roux. Add to stock pot and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Strain sauce through chinois and return sauce to pot.
Add garlic paste mixture to pot to and simmer another 5 minutes or until nappé consistency is achieved. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: ROASTED RED PEPPER CHICKPEA PURÉE
instructions: Combine chickpeas in pressure cooker with salt, cumin, and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover by 1 inch. Cover and bring to full pressure. Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid and drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.
Discard bay leaf, and transfer beans to food processor.
Add garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, bell pepper, and tahini. Process until smooth, adding bean liquid as necessary to form smooth, thick puree. Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with paprika and serve with pita.
Seasonal variation: In Winter/Fall, substitute two heads roasted garlic for roasted red pepper and remove chopped garlic.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper Coulis

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F.

Arrange peppers on half sheet pan, and roast in oven until blistered, about 20-30 minutes. Transfer peppers to covered, small bowl to steam for 10 minutes. When peppers are cool, remove skins and seeds.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over a medium flame and sweat onions with garlic until onions are translucent.
Combine peppers with onion-garlic mixture in VitaMix and blend until creamy. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil through feed tube, slowly while machine is running.
Add warm vegetable stock as needed for desired consistency. Add lemon juice to taste. Adjust seasonings with salt, pepper, and hot sauce.

recipes.name: ROMAINE SALAD WITH SHERRY VINAIGRETTE
instructions: Whisk together vinegar, mustard, shallot, and salt in bowl. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking until dressing is properly emulsified.
Toss lettuce, celery, and apple in bowl with enough dressing to coat.
Divide salad into portions, ladling on extra dressing as needed. Garnish each salad with raisins and pecans.

recipes.name: ROMESCO SAUCE
instructions: Combine tomatoes in small bowl and set aside.

Arrange peppers on stove top, over direct flame, turning often as peppers become blackened and blistered. Transfer peppers to small bowl and cover. Allow peppers steam for 10 minutes. When peppers are cool, remove skins and seeds.
Heat cast iron skillet over medium flame. Toast chili each side until flexible. Do not scorch.
Remove seeds and transfer chili to 2 1/2 quart pot with water to cover. Simmer until chili softens, about 5 minutes. Drain chilis and set them aside, reserving soaking water.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons oil over low flame, add garlic, and sweat until garlic has softened. Add tomatoes and peppers. Increase heat to medium-high and sauté until vegetables begin to caramelize.
In food processor, combine tomatoes, chili, hazelnuts, almonds, vinegar, and remaining 1/4 cup of oil. Blend until smooth. If sauce is too thick, add chili soaking water to processor to thin sauce.

recipes.name: ROSEMARY AND GARLIC PIZZELLE (FOR WHITE BEAN SPREAD)
recipes.description: (YEAR-ROUND)

ingredients.name: small amount of olive oil to grease pizzelle maker

instructions: In small bowl, sift together dry ingredients.
In separate small bowl, whisk together wet ingredients.
Using whisk, mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Mixture should be consistency of heavy cream. Add extra water, if necessary.
Lightly brush or spray small amount of oil on cooking surface of pizzelle maker. Plug in machine and wait until light turns red. When machine is ready, ladle 1/4 teaspoon of batter for each pizzelle.
After pouring mixture, close cover of machine and cook 1 1/2 minutes until pizzelles are lightly browned and crisp. Remove from machine with an offset spatula.

recipes.name: ROSEMARY, SQUASH, AND LEEK DUMPLINGS
recipes.description: (FALL/WINTER)

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. In medium bowl, combine the squash, 2 tablespoons olive oil, rosemary, salt and pepper to taste. Toss to coat. Transfer squash to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast 20 minutes or until tender. Set aside.
When cool, transfer squash to food processor and blend until smooth. Set aside.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in 12-inch sauté pan over medium flame. Sweat leeks and garlic until tender, about 3-5 minutes. Add ginger juice.
Transfer vegetables to medium bowl and add sesame oil, mirin, lemon juice, and pureed squash. Mix to combine and season to taste.
In small bowl, slurry arrowroot and water to smooth consistency. Set aside.

Spoon 1 tablespoon filling in middle of wonton skin. Lightly brush outer edge of wonton wrapper with arrowroot mixture. Fold wrapper in half to form half moon, pinching edges together. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers and filling.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1/4 cup oil over medium-high flame. Add 6-7 wontons at a time and pan fry each side until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes a side. Whisk and combine all dipping sauce ingredients in small bowl and serve with dumplings.

recipes.name: SAUCE ESPAGNOLE (BROWN SAUCE)

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until golden.
Add tomatoes and sauté for few minutes longer or until slightly caramelized.
Add 7 cups stock and bring to boil. Lower heat to simmer.
Slowly whisk remaining cup of warmed stock with cooled roux.
Slowly add roux-stock mixture back into sauce.
Simmer uncovered about 30 minutes or until reduced by half and nappé is achieved.
Strain through chinois. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: Sauce Supreme
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat Velouté Sauce over low flame and simmer 2-3 minutes or until warmed through.
Slowly whisk in heavy cream, and mix until incorporated.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED CHICKEN LIVERS WITH ONION, APPLE, AND FRISÉE

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large sauté pan over medium heat. Sweat onions until translucent. Add vinegar and raise heat slightly. Continue to cook until onions begin to brown and caramelize, adding a bit of water if onions begin to stick to pan. When onions are tender and browned, add salt and pepper. Remove onions from pan and set aside.

Season livers with salt and pepper. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to same pan and heat over medium-high flame. Add livers, making sure not to crowd pan. Sauté livers about 2 minutes on each side. When livers are done, add brandy to pan, and swirl to combine.
Transfer cooked livers to paper-lined sheet tray to drain.
Add onions back to pan, followed by livers.
Toss lemon juice in bowl with apples, salt, and pepper. Add frisée and set aside.
In separate small bowl, combine vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until dressing has emulsified.
Toss salad with dressing. Serve with caramelized onions and liver.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED MUSHROOMS WITH HERBS
instructions: In large pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add shallots and garlic, lower heat, and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add mushrooms with salt to pan and sauté until well caramelized, stirring only occasionally, 10-15 minutes.
Add wine to pan, turn up heat, and simmer until wine has evaporated.
All flour to pan. Stir until incorporated. Add stock and simmer until sauce is thickened, about 10 minutes.
Season with additional salt and pepper, if needed.
Add cheese to taste, if using.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED SWISS CHARD

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: Remove stems from chard and discard or save for another dish. Roughly chop leaves and wash. In 1-gallon pot, cook chard over medium heat, stirring frequently until wilted but still bright green. You don’t have to add water to pot; water clinging to leaves from washing is enough to cook them.
Remove chard from pot and squeeze out any excess liquid. Finely chop.
Warm oil with garlic in 10-inch sauté pan. When garlic just begins to color, add chard and stir to warm through. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Remove from heat and stir in rosemary.

recipes.name: SCALLION, EDAMAME, AND LEEK DUMPLINGS
recipes.description: (SPRING/SUMMER)

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring 6 cups water and 1 tablespoon sea salt to boil. Blanch edamame until tender, about 5-7 minutes. Shock and drain in colander for about 5 minutes. Set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add leeks and sweat until tender. Add garlic and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Continue sweating a few minutes more. Transfer leeks and garlic to food processor and puree with edamame to form a creamy pipe-able consistency.
Transfer mixture from food processor to medium-size bowl. Add ginger juice, sesame oil, mirin, lemon juice, cilantro, chives, and mint. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside.
In small bowl, slurry arrowroot and water to smooth consistency. Set aside.

Place 1 scant tablespoon filling in middle of wonton wrapper. Lightly brush outer edge of wonton wrapper with arrowroot mixture. Fold wrapper in half to form half moon, pinching edges together. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers and filling.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1/4 cup oil over medium-high flame. Add 6-7 wontons at a time and pan fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer with slotted spoon to paper towel to drain.
Combine and whisk all dipping sauce ingredients in small bowl and serve with dumplings.

recipes.name: Scallion-Ginger Sauce
instructions: In bowl mix all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.name: SEA PALM, WAKAME AND DULSE SEAWEED SALAD WITH CREAMY CARROT DRESSING
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss carrots with olive oil, garlic, and rosemary. Transfer carrots to parchment-lined half sheet tray. Roast carrots until tender (about 20-30 minutes). Set aside to cool, reserving 1/4 pound carrots for dressing.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring sea palm, with enough water to cover, and shoyu to boil. Lower flame and simmer 20 minutes uncovered. Drain sea palm and set aside.
